sa: अशीलः कर्कशस्तीक्ष्णो मूल् लुब्धोऽजितेन्द्रियः॥ त्यक्तधर्मा त्वधर्मात्मा भूतानामहिते रतः। येन वैरं विनारण्ये सत्वमास्थाय केवलम्॥ कर्णनासापहारेण भगिनी मे विरूपिता। अस्य भार्यां जनस्थानात् सीतां सुरसुतोपमाम्॥ आनयिष्यामि विक्रम्य सहायस्तत्र मे भव।
en: He is of a vile character, crabbed, foolish, covetous, of uncontrolled senses, bereft of morality, sinful, and ever engaged in the evil of all creatures, by whom, violently without hostility my sister has been deformed in the forest by having her nose and ears cut off. Of him will I carry off by force from Janasthāna, his wife, Sītā, resembling the daughter of a celestial.

sa: नानाप्रहरणाः क्षिप्रमितो गच्छत सत्वराः। जनस्थानं हतस्थानं भूतं पूर्वं खरालयम्॥ तत्रास्यतां जनस्थाने शून्ये निहतराक्षसे। पौरुषं बलमाश्रित्य त्रासमुत्सृज्य दूरतः॥
en: Equipped with various weapons, do you speedily take yourself to Janasthāna-that field of carnage-which ere this contained the abode of Khara; and casting off fear at a distance, do you sojourn in vacant Janasthāna with all its Raksasas slain (by Rama).

sa: सुप्रीतस्तेन वाक्येन लक्ष्मणस्य महाद्युतिः। विमृशन् रोचयामास देशं सर्वगुणान्वितम्॥ स तं रुचिरमाक्रम्य देशमाश्रमकर्मणि। हस्ते गृहीत्वा हस्तेन रामः सौमित्रिमब्रवीत्॥
en: Well pleased with the words of Lakşınana, that highly effulgent one, after dure reflection, selected a site having every recommendation. Going to that romantic spot for rearing an asylum, Rama, taking the hand of Sumitra's son in his, said to him.

sa: पुरा वृत्रवधे वृत्ते स चाहं च जयैषिणौ। आदित्यमुपयातौ स्वो ज्वलन्तं रश्मिमालिनम्॥ आवृत्याकाशमार्गेण जवेन स्वर्गतौ भृशम्। मध्यं प्राप्ते तु सूर्ये तु जटायुरवसीदति ॥
en: Formerly, while engaged in the destruction of Vrtra, he and I, burning for victory, soared in the sky near the flaming sun, garlanded by glory. Thence impetuously wheeling round, we went to the celestial regions along the etherial way. And it came to pass that, coming midway of the sun, Jațāyu was faint.

sa: पर्वतारोहणं चैव सागरस्यापि लङ्घनम्। समुद्रवचनाच्चैव मैनाकस्य च दर्शनम् ॥ राक्षसीतर्जनं चैव च्छायाग्राहस्य दर्शनम्। सिंहिकायाश्च निधनं लङ्कामलयदर्शनम् ॥
en: Hanuman's ascension of the mountain, and his bounding over the main; and his sight of the Maināka at the injunction of Ocean; the roaring of Raksasis; Hanuman's meeting with the Rākşasa Chāyāgrāha. Hanumān's destruction of Simhikāyā; and Hanuman's sight of Lankā.

sa: इत्युक्तः प्रश्रितं वाक्यं धर्मार्थसहितं हितम्। परुषं वालिना रामो निहतेन विचेतसा॥ तं निष्प्रभमिवादित्यं मुक्ततोयमिवाम्बुदम्। उक्तवाक्यं हरिश्रेष्ठमुपशान्तमिवानलम्॥ धर्मार्थगुणसम्पन्नं हरीश्वरमनुत्तमम् । अधिक्षिप्तस्तदा रामः पश्चाद् वालिनमब्रवीत्॥
en: And thus Rāma was addressed by Vāli, wounded and senseless, with those modest, pious and auspicious words. And being thus reproached he spoke to that excellent lord of monkeys, gifted with virtue and other accomplishments, resembling the Sun shorn of its lustre, a cloud which has already discharged its waters and fire extinguished.

sa: प्रतिवक्तुं प्रकृष्टे हि नापकृष्टस्तु शक्नुयात्। यदयुक्तं मया पूर्वं प्रमादाद् वाक्यमप्रियम् ॥ तत्रापि खलु मां दोषं कर्तुं नार्हसि राघव। त्वं हि दृष्टार्थतत्वज्ञः प्रजानां च हिते रतः। कार्यकारणसिद्धौ च प्रसन्ना बुद्धिरव्यया॥
en: An inferior person can by no means address his superior improperly. It does not behove you, O Rāghava, therefore to blame me for those unpleasant words which I used towards you, out of foolishness. You have acquired a practical mastery over the principles of religion and are ever engaged in the welfare of your subjects. Your eternal power of ascertaining the crime and meeting its condign punishment is perfectly clear.

sa: गुरुश्च राजा च पिता च वृद्धः क्रोधात् प्रहर्षादथवापि कामात्। यद् व्यादिशेत् कार्यमवेक्ष्य धर्म कस्तं न कुर्यादनृशंसवृत्तिः। ५९।।
en: Who of us, having no tendency to wickedness, shall not obey the command of our father knowing it to be righteousness, who is old, our monarch and preceptor in military training, be it an outcome of his desires, anger or joy.

sa: त्रैलोक्यराज्यादपि हि तप एव विशिष्यते॥ तपसा हि सुतप्तेन शक्यो मोक्षस्तपोबलात्। अहो प्रभावो ब्रह्मर्षेश्च्यवनस्य महात्मनः॥ इच्छयैष तपोवीर्यादन्याँल्लोकान् सृजेदपि।
en: Penances are superior to even the kingdom of the three worlds. With penances wellperformed, Liberation itself may be acquired. Mark the power of the great and celestial Rishi Chyavana derived from his penances! He can. at his pleasure, create even other'worlds.

sa: तत: कथान्ते व्यासस्तं प्रज्ञाचक्षुषमीश्वरम्। प्रोवाच वदतां श्रेष्ठः पुनरेव स तद् वचः॥ प्रीयमाणो महातेजाः सर्ववेदविदां वरः। विदितं मम राजेन्द्र यत् ते हृदि विवक्षितम्॥ दह्यमानस्य शोकेन तव पुत्रकृतेन वै। गान्धार्याश्चैव यद् दुःखं हृदि तिष्ठति नित्यदा॥ कुन्त्याश्च यन्महाराज द्रौपद्याश्च हृदि स्थितम्। यच्च धारयते तीव्र दुःखं पुत्रविनाशजम्॥ सुभद्रा कृष्णभगिनी तच्चापि विदितं मम। श्रुत्वा समागममिमं सर्वेषां वस्तुतो नृप॥ संशयच्छेदनार्थाय प्राप्तः कौरवनन्दन। इमे च देवगन्धर्वाः सर्वे चेमे महर्षयः॥ पश्यन्त
en: At the close of the conversation the highly energetic Vyasa, that foremost of eloquent men, that first of all persons knowing the Vedas highly pleased, addressed the blind monarch and once more said, 'Burning as you are with grief on account of your children, I know, O king of kings, what object is cherished by you in your heart. I know the sorrow which always exists in the heart of Gandhari, that which exists in the heart of Kunti, and that also which is cherished by Draupadi in her heart, and that burning grief, on. account of the death of her son, which Krishna's sister Subhadra also cherishes. Hearing of this meeting, O king, of yours with all these princes and princesses of your house., I have come here, O delighter of the Kauravas, for removing your doubts. Let the celestials and Gan

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच ये नृत्यगीते कुशला जनाः सदा ह्ययाचमानाः सहिताश्चरन्ति। तथाविधानामेष लोको महर्षे परं गन्ता धृतराष्ट्रो न तत्र॥
en: Dhritarashtra said They who never beg, they who cultivate music and dancing, and always move about happily, proceed to such regions. O great Rishi, I shall go to a region which is higher. Indeed Dhritarashtra shall not have to go there.

sa: तमो व्यक्तं शिवं धाम रजो योनिः सनातनः। प्रकृतिर्विकारः प्रायः प्रधानं प्रभवाप्ययौ॥ अनुद्रिक्तमनूनं वाप्यकम्पमचलं ध्रुवम्। सदसच्चैव तत् सर्वमव्यक्तं त्रिगुणं स्मृतम्। ज्ञेयानि नामधेयानि नरैरध्यात्मचिन्तकैः॥
en: The unmanifest, consisting of the three qualities, is said to be darkness, unperceived, holy constant, unborn, womb, eternal, Nature, change or modification, destruction, Pradhana, production, and absorption, undeveloped, not small (i.e., vast), unshaking, immovable, fixed, existent, and non-existent. All these names should be known by those who meditate on matters about the soul.

sa: तथा लोका मानुषा ये च दिव्याः प्रजापतेश्चापि ये वै महान्तः। ते ते जिता देवराज्यं च कृत्स्नं बृहस्पतिर्याजयेच्चेन्नरेन्द्र॥
en: And, O king, if Brihaspati act as your priest you will be able to conquer all the regions inhabited by men, and the heavenly regions and all the highest regions created by Prajapati and even the entire kingdom of the celestials.

sa: न हन्येरंश्च राजानो राज्ञश्चाज्ञां कृता भवेत्। इति संचिन्त्य स तदा फाल्गुनः पुरुषर्षभः॥ प्रोवाच वाक्यं धर्मज्ञः सैन्धवान् युद्धदुर्मदान्।
en: I must act in such a way as not to falsify the words of king Yudhishthira the just. Having arrived at this conclusion, Phalguna, that foremost of men, then said to those Saindhavas who were all dreadful in battle, these words:

sa: तस्य वृत्रगृहीतस्य मोहः समभवन्महान्॥ रथन्तरेण तं तात वसिष्ठः प्रत्यबोधयत्। ततो वृत्रं शरीरस्थं जघान भरतर्षभ। शतक्रतुरदृश्येन वज्रेणेतीह नः श्रुतम्॥ इदं धन॑ रहस्यं वै शक्रेणोक्तं महर्षिषु। ऋषिभिश्च मम प्रोक्तं तन्निबोध जनाधिप।॥
en: And overtaken by Vritra, he was filled with great illusion. And, O venerable sir, the most powerful of Bharata's race, we have heard that Vasishtha comforted Indra and that the God of a Hundred Sacrifices killed Vritra in his body by means of his invisible thunderbolt, and know, O prince, that this religious mystery was recited by Shakra to the great sages, and they in turn told it to me.

sa: तं शिखण्डी समासाद्य त्वया गुप्तो महाव्रतम्॥ जघान पुरुषव्याघ्रं शरैः संनतपूर्वभिः। स एष पतितः शेते शरतल्पे पितामहः॥ त्वां प्राप्य पुरुषव्याघ्र वृत्रः प्राप्येव वासवम्।
en: Being under your powerful protection Sikhandin encountered him and with his straight shafts slew that foremost of men. O mighty one, as the Asura Vritra courted his death obtaining Vasava for his foe, so having obtained you (as his foe) there lies on a bed of arrows that grandsire (wrapt in eternal sleep).

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नः सात्यकिश्च द्रौपदेया वृकोदरः। जनमेजयः शिखण्डी च प्रवीराश्च प्रभद्रकाः॥ चेदिकेकयपञ्चाला यमौ मत्स्याश्च दंशिताः। सम्भ्यधावन् राधेयं जिघांसन्तः प्रहारिणम्॥
en: Thereupon, Dhristadyumna, Satyaki, the five sons of Draupadi, Vrikodara, Janmejaya, Shikhandin and many leading warriors among Probhadrakas and many amongst the Chedis, the Kekayas and the Panchalas, the twins, the Matsyas, all clad in mail rushed upon Karna to kill him.

sa: को हि शक्तो रणे कर्णं विधुन्वानं महद् धनुः॥ विमुञ्चन्तं शरान् घोरान् दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि चाहवे। जेतुं पुरुषशार्दूलं शार्दूलमिव वेगिनम्॥
en: Who, indeed, was able to subdue Karna in battle, that foremost of persons, possessed of the speed of a tiger, while that mighty bowman was shaking his bow and shooting forth his terrible arrows and exhausting his celestial weapons in battle.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच मार्कण्डेयादिभिर्विप्रैः पाण्डवैश्च महात्मभिः। कथाभिरनुकूलाभिः सह स्थित्वा जनार्दनः॥ ततस्तैः संविदं कृत्वा यथावन्मधुसूदनः। आरुरुक्षू रथं सत्यामाह्वयामास केशवः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The slayer of Madhusudana Keshava Janardana (Krishna), having talked on various agreeable topics with the illustrious Pandavas and with the Brahmanas headed by Markandeya and then having bade them all farewell, ascended his chariot and called for Satyabhama.

sa: कृषि साध्विति मन्यन्ते तत्र हिंसा परा स्मृता। कर्षन्तो लाइलैः पुंसोध्नन्ति भूमिशयान् बहून्। जीवानन्यांश्च बहुशस्तत्र किं प्रतिभाति ते॥
en: Agriculture is considered to be a praiseworthy occupation, but it is well-known that even in it great harm is done to animal life. In ploughing the ground, various creatures and animal lives are destroyed. What is your opinion on this matter?

sa: तेन कामात् कृतं मिथ्या बाह्मणस्येति नः श्रुतिः। स ब्राह्मणैः परित्यक्तस्ततो वै जगतः पतिः॥ पुरोहितापचाराच्च तस्य राज्ञो यदृच्छया। न ववर्ष सहस्राक्षास्ततोऽपीड्यन्त वै प्रजाः॥
en: We have heard that he wantonly told a falsehood to a Brahmana. That ruler of earth was therefore abandoned by all the Brahmanas. Thus without having had a priest, the king became sinful and therefore the deity of one thousand eyes (Indra) stopped to shower rain; and thus his subjects began to suffer.

sa: अर्जुनस्तु खमावतें लोहितप्राशनैः खगैः॥ अत्र मध्ये यथार्कस्य रश्मयस्तिग्मतेजसः। दिशासु च तथा राजन्नसंख्याताः शरास्तदा।॥ सकृदेवानतं शेकू स्थमभ्यसितुं परे।
en: Arjuna covered the entire sky with blooddrinking arrows. As the fierce rays of the sun are within a small vessel. O king, those numberless shafts of his were in the sky. They could see once his car only when brought near.

sa: ऋषय ऊचुः सकृत् सतां संगतं लिप्सितव्यं ततः परं भविता भव्यमेव। नातिकामेत् सत्पुरुषेण संगतं तस्मात् सतां संगत् लिप्सितव्यम्॥
en: The Rishis said The company of virtuous ones is desirable (even for a time); thereafter what is fated will come to pass. The opportunity of friendship with virtuous men should not be lost; therefore is the company of virtuous men desirable.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच क्वस्था वीराः पाण्डवास्ते बभूवुः। कुतश्चैते श्रुतवन्तः प्रियं तत्। किं वाकार्पर्द्वादशेऽब्दे व्यतीते तन्मे सर्वं भगवान् व्याकरोतु॥
en: Janamejaya said : Where did the heroic Pandavas dwell (at that time) and from whom did they receive this joyful news and what did they do after the twelve years of their exile? O adorable one, relate all this to me.

sa: उभौ च देवौ पृथिवीं दिवं च दिशः शुक्रो भुवनं बिभर्ति। तस्माद् दिशः सरितश्च स्रवन्ति तस्मात् समुद्रा विहिता महान्ताः। योगिनस्तं प्रपश्यन्ति भगवन्तं सनातनम्॥
en: car The seed supports the two gods (the creature-soul and the supreme soul), the earth and the heaven, the cardinal points of the earth and the universe. From that spring up the cardinal point and the latter and from that the vast oceans have originated. The ascetics perceive that Lord who is Eternal.

sa: तेभ्यः प्रयुज्य तां पूजां प्रोवाच मधुसूदनः। भगवन्तः क्व संसिद्धाः का वीथी भवतामिह॥ किं वा कार्यं भगवतामहं किं करवाणि वः। केनार्थेनोपसम्प्राप्ता भगवन्तो महीतलम्॥
en: Having paid them due honours, the slayer of Madhu said to them. What is the object of you prosperous ones? Where are you going? What are you, prosperous beings, going to do? What shall I do for you? With what object have you, prosperous ones, come down to the face of the earth?

sa: त्यक्तात्मानः सह दुर्योधनेन हृष्टा योद्धं पाण्डवान् सर्वयोधाः। तेषां मध्ये प्रविशेथा यदि त्वं न तन्मतं मम दाशार्ह वीर॥
en: All those soldiers, united with Duryodhana and regardless of self are delighted at the prospect of) fighting with the Pandavas and, O you heroic scion of the Dasharha race, it is not my opinion that you should enter in their midst.

sa: धर्मेणाप्तं निधनं तस्य मन्ये यो योत्स्यते पाण्डवैः पापबुद्धिः। मिथ्या ग्लहे निर्जिता वै नृशंसैः संवत्सरान् वै द्वादश राजपुत्राः॥
en: That man of wicked intelligence fights with the Pandavas. I shall regard this death as being justly got. Conquered by deceit at the game of dice by those inhuman ones, we ourselves, the sons of a king, for twelve long years.

sa: इन्द्रो वा ते हरिमान् वज्रहस्तः पुरस्ताद् यातु समरेऽरीन् विनिघ्नन्। सुग्रीवयुक्तेन रथेन वा ते पश्चात् कृष्णो रक्षतु वासुदेवः॥
en: Either Indra on his steed, thunderbolt in his hand will go before you in battle, killing your enemies or mounted on a chariot with Sugriva (name of horse) and other steeds Krishna, the son of Vasudeva will protect you from behind.

sa: तमाशु निशितैः पार्थं बिभेद दशभिः शरैः॥ ततः पार्थो महातेजा विशिखानग्नितेजसः। चिक्षेप समरे क्रुद्धस्त्रयोदश शिलाशितान्॥ अथास्य युगमेकेन चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्। षष्ठेन च शिरः कायाच्छरेण रथसारथेः॥ त्रिभिस्त्रिवेणुं समरे द्वाभ्यामक्षं महारथः।
en: And immediately struck Partha with ten sharp arrows. Then the highly energetic Partha, worked up with rage, discharged thirteen sharp and fiery arrow3; with one he cut off the yoke, with four the four horses and with the sixth he cut off the head of the charioteer with three, the great car-warrior, pierced in battle, the three bamboo poles, and with two his two wheels.

sa: अज्ञातैर्यदि वा ज्ञातैः कर्तव्यं नृपतेः प्रियम्। प्राय: प्रधानाः पुरुषाः क्षोभयन्त्यरिवाहिनीम्॥ निगृह्यन्ते च युद्धेषु मोक्ष्यन्ते चैव सैनिकैः। सेनाजीवाश्च ये राज्ञां विषये सन्ति मानवाः॥ तैः सङ्गम्य नृपार्थाय यतितव्यं यथातथम्। यद्येवं पाण्डवै राजन् भवद्विषयवासिभिः॥ यदृच्छया मोक्षितोऽसि तत्र का परिदेवना। न चैतत् साधु यद् राजन् पाण्डवास्त्वां नृपोत्तमम्॥
en: Should always do what is agreeable to the king, whether they happen to be known to the king or unknown to him. Often happens that even the foremost of men who are capable of crushing the enemy are often defeated by them; under such circumstances they are often rescued by their troops. The warriors living in a king's dominion should always combine and try their utmost for their king. If, therefore, O king, the Pandavas who live in your dominion have rescued you, what is there to be sorry for? O foremost of kings, O monarch, it was not proper for the Pandavas.

sa: त्वया परिषदो मध्ये श्लाघते स नराधिपः। पुत्रो ममानुरूपश्च शूरश्चेति कुलोद्वहः॥
en: The king speaks highly of you in the court: My son, after me, is heroic and the supporter (of the prestige) of the race.

sa: स तेन सर्वसैन्येन भीमेन कुरुनन्दनः। वृतः परिययौ हृष्टः सुहृदः सम्प्रहर्षयन्॥
en: The son of Kuru, surrounded by all those troops, which were terrible looking, went forward with a light heart causing delight to his friends.

sa: युष्माकं विक्रमादद्य मुक्तोऽहं स्वस्तिमानिह। तस्माद् भवन्तो मत्स्यानामीश्वराः सर्व एव हि॥
en: By your prowess today I have been saved from peril. I am now crowned with victory. Do you all become the kings of Matsya's.

sa: पञ्च नस्तात दीयन्तां ग्रामा इति महाद्युते। अविरथलं वृकस्थलं माकन्दी वारणावतम्॥ अवसानं महाबाहो कञ्चिदेकं च पञ्चमम्। इति दुर्योधनो वाच्यः सुहृदश्चास्य केशव॥
en: O you of great luster, (this was the massage) give us, O sire, five villages namely, Avisthala, Vrikasthala, Makandi, Varanavata and any one for the last or the fifth, O you of long arms. In these terms was Duryodhana to be addressed and his friends too, O Keshava.

sa: रोचते मे महाबाहो क्रियतां यदनन्तरम्। नायकास्तव सेनायां क्रियन्तामिह सप्त वै॥
en: All this I approve of, O you of long arms, and now do what ought to be done; select seven leaders for your army.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः प्रविश्य विदुरो धृतराष्ट्रनिवेशनम्। अब्रवीत् प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं चिन्तयानं नराधिपम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then Vidura having entered the palace of Dhritarashtra said with clasped hands to the lord of men who was absorbed in thought.

sa: यज्ञवाटस्य ते भूमिः कृष्यतां तेन भारत। तत्र यज्ञो नृपश्रेष्ठ प्रभूतान्नः सुसंस्कृतः॥ प्रवर्ततां यथान्यायं सर्वतो ह्यनिवारितः।
en: O descendant of Bharata, with it plough the sacrificial ground. At that spot let there commence, O foremost of kings, with due rites and without any disturbance, the sacrifice sanctified with Mantra and abounding in eatables.

sa: कथयित्वा तु तत् सर्वं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो युधिष्ठिरः। अरणीसहितं तस्मै ब्राह्मणाय न्यवेदयत्॥
en: Having described everything to the Brahmanas, Yudhishthira gave over to the Brahmana the fire sticks along with the churning staff which he had lost.

sa: शिल्पिभिर्विविधैश्चैव क्रीडास्तत्र प्रयोजिताः। तत्र माल्यानि मांसानि भक्ष्यं पेयं च सत्कृतम्॥
en: And sent there various artists for the amusement (of Shalya and his men) and provided there all sorts of eatables, drinks, meats and garlands.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्ते तु सव्रीडः सुशर्माऽऽसीदधोमुखः। स मुक्तोऽभ्येत्य राजानमभिवाद्य प्रतस्थिवान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus addressed Susharma was filled with shame and bent down his head. And liberated and bowing to the king he went away.

sa: दुर्योधनमुखा दृष्ट्वा क्षयं यास्यन्ति कौरवाः। न भीमार्जुनयोर्भीता लप्स्यन्ते विजयं विभो॥
en: The Kauravas, headed by Duryodhana, will be destroyed, struck by the terror of Bhima and Arjuna; and victory will not be gained, O Lord,

sa: शरान् विसृजतोस्तूर्णं साधु साध्वित्यपूजयन्॥ द्रोणं हि समरे कोऽन्यो योद्धुमर्हति फाल्गुनात्।
en: (They all) admired Drona who quickly shot arrows, exclaiming “Well done! well done! Who else can fight with Drona in battle except Phalguni (Arjuna)?

sa: सहदेवो मया नित्यं नकुलश्च निवारितौ। शक्तौ विध्वंसने तेषां शत्रूणां भीमविक्रमौ॥
en: Nakula and Sahadeva of dreadful valour were also fully capable to slay those enemies, but they have been prevented by me all the time.

sa: अस्यत: कर्णिनालीकान् मार्गणआन् हृदयच्छिदः। प्रत्येता न समः कश्चिद् युधि गाण्डीवधन्वनः॥
en: There is no equal in battle of the wielder of the Gandiva bow shooting winged arrows, Nalikas (muskets) and arrows penetrating into the heart.

sa: एवं विवस्वता तात छन्नेनोत्तमतेजसा। निर्दग्धाः शात्रवाः सर्वे वसता भुवि सर्वशः॥
en: And O child, remaining concealed in every part of the earth, Vivasvata, endued with excellent power, at last entirely burnt up all his foes,

sa: सर्वे चैव महात्मानः सर्वे धर्मार्थकोविदाः। येषां युधिष्ठिरो राजा कस्माद् धर्मेऽपराध्नुयुः॥
en: All of them are noble and well acquainted with virtue and worldly profit. They have Yudhishthira as their king. How can they injure virtue?

sa: नान्यः कर्ता ऋते भीमान्ममाद्य मनसः प्रियम्। तत उत्थाय रात्रौ सा विहाय शयनं स्वकम्॥ प्राद्रवन्नाथमिच्छन्ती कृष्णा नाथवती सती। भवनं भीमसेनस्य क्षिप्रमायतलोचना॥ दुःखेन महता युक्ता मानसेन मनस्विनी।
en: Save and except Bhima there is none else that can do this very day what is agreeable to me. Then afflicted with great woe that largeeyed Krishna of spacious breast and approved chastity, with mighty lords as her protectors, rose up at night, left her own bed and repaired speedily to the abode of Bhimasena, desirous of accosting her lord.

sa: धनुष्यनवरचासीत् तस्य शिष्यो महात्मनः। दृष्टपूर्वो मया वीर चरन्त्या पाण्डवान् प्रति॥
en: A mighty bowman he was the disciple of the high-souled (Arjuna); O hero, I saw him before while I was living with the Pandavas.

sa: राजन् विद्वान् भवान् दान्तः सत्यसंधो जितेन्द्रियः। नैवंविधाः प्रमुह्यन्ते नराः कस्याञ्चिदापदि॥
en: O king, you are well leamed, tamed, observant of vows and subdued sense, men of such type are not overwhelmed by any calamity whatever.

sa: भक्त्या ह्यस्य विरुध्यन्ते तव पुत्रैः सदैव ते। अनर्हानेव तु वधे धर्मयुक्तान् विकर्मणा॥ योऽक्लेशयत् पाण्डुपुत्रान् यो विद्वेष्ट्यधुनापि वै। सर्वोपायनियन्तव्यः सानुगः पापपूरुषः॥
en: Out of regard for him, they are ever against your sons. He who troubles the sons of Pandu endued with virtue and undeserving of injury by unworthy actions and he who despises them even now, that evil-minded man, along with his followers, should be checked by all means.

sa: स्वर्यातेऽहं पितरि तं स्वराज्ये संन्यवेशयम्। विचित्रवीर्यं राजानं भृत्यो भूत्वा ह्यधश्चरः॥
en: My father having gone to heaven I placed that Vichitravirya at the head of my own kingdom and myself become a subordinate to him.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः पुरंदरं विष्णुरुवाच भुवनेश्वरम्। अमृतं दीयतामस्मै क्रियताममरैः समः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then did Vishnu thus speak to Purandara, the lord of the universe-Give unto him nectar and make him equal to the immortals.

sa: अपत्यार्थ महाराज प्रसादं कृतवांश्च सः। त्रीन् स पुत्रानजनयत् तदा भरतसत्तम॥
en: To beget children, and great king he too complied with our request and then did he beget children, O you best among the Bharatas.

sa: न मामकान् पाण्डवास्ते समर्थाः प्रतिवीक्षितुम्। पराक्रान्तो ह्यहं पाण्डून् सपुत्रान् योद्धमोहवे॥
en: These Pandavas are not even able to gaze on my soldiers. I am sufficiently powerful to challenge the Pandus with their sons to fight.

sa: महिषी पाण्डुपुत्राणां दुहिता दुपदस्य च। इमामवस्थां सम्प्राप्ता मदन्या का जिजीविषेत्॥
en: Queen of the sons of Pandu, and daughter of Drupada, who else but me wishes to live, having been reduced to such a plight?

sa: कण्व उवाच मातलिस्त्वब्रवीदेनं बुद्धिरत्र कृता मया। जामातृभावेन वृतः सुमुखस्तव पुत्रजः॥
en: Kanva said Matali then said-"In this connection, a plan has been found by me; Sumukha born of your son is selected as my son-in-law.

sa: पितामहस्य द्रोणस्य विदुरस्य च धीमतः। ब्राह्मणानां च साधूनां राज्ञश्च नगरस्य च॥ पश्यतां कुरुमुख्यानां सर्वेषामेव तत्त्वतः। दानशीलं मृदुं दान्तं धर्मशीलमनुव्रतम्॥ यत् त्वामुपधिना राजन् द्यूते वञ्चितवांस्तदा। न चापत्रपते तेन नृशंसः स्वेन कर्मणा॥
en: When before the very eyes of the grandfather (Bhishma), Drona, the wise Vidura and the Brahmanas, holy men and the entire city and before all the chiefs among the Kurus, he, O king, by means of deceit, defeated you at a game of dice, you who are attached to the habit of making gifts, who are of virtuous habits and life of austere vows, he was not ashamed of his cruel act.

sa: विदुर उवाच एवं कृतपणौ क्रुद्धौ तत्राभिजग्मतुस्तदा। विरोचनसुधन्वानौ प्रह्लाद यत्र तिष्ठति॥
en: Vidura said In this way having laid wagers, Virochana and Sudhanvan, enraged at each other, then went to the place where Prahrada was staying.

sa: अद्यापि चाहमुद्विग्नस्तक्षन्नस्माद् बिभेमि वै। क्षिप्रं छिन्धि शिरांसि त्वं करिष्येऽनुग्रहं तव॥
en: To this day, O wood cutter, am I anxious and dread this. Quickly cut off his heads. I shall bestow a favour on you.

sa: ते त्वां देवाः सगन्धर्वा ऋषयश्च महाद्युते। प्रसादयन्ति चेन्द्राणी नहुषाय प्रदीयताम्॥
en: They, the gods with the Gandharvas and Rishis, pray you, O you of great luster, to make over the Queen of Indra to Nahusha.

sa: तमब्रवीद् राजयुत्री समुपेत्य नरर्षभम्। प्रणयं भावयन्ती सा सखीमध्य इदं वचः॥
en: Then approaching that best of men, that princess, bending low with humility addressed to him (the following) words in the midst of her companions.

sa: दिवमावृत्य शब्दस्तु निवृत्तः शुश्रुवे पुनः। सृष्टो मघवता वज्रः प्रपतन्निव पर्वते॥
en: Having reached the very sky that sound came back and was heard again like that of thunderbolt when hurled by Indra against a mountain.

sa: महानप्येकजो वृक्षो बलवान् सुप्रतिष्ठितः। प्रसह्य एव वातेन सस्कन्धो मर्दितु क्षणात्॥
en: A large tree standing by itself, through strong and firm, can in a moment be brought down with its truck by a strong wind.

sa: ते प्रविश्य महेष्वासाः सभां सर्वे महौजसः॥ आसनानि विचित्राणि भेजिरे सूर्यवर्चसः।
en: All those mighty bowmen of great prowess having entered the hall, those of the effulgence of the sun seated themselves on the variegated seats.

sa: न कुर्यां कर्म बीभत्सं युध्यमानः कथंचन। तेन देवमनुष्येषु बीभत्सुरिति विश्रुतः॥
en: I have never committed a hateful work in the field of battle and hence I am known as Bibhatsu amongst men and celestials. I

sa: न चेत् प्रबुध्यते कृष्ण नरकायैव गच्छति। तस्य प्रबोधः प्रज्ञैव प्रज्ञाचक्षुस्तरिष्यति॥
en: If he does not awake, he goes to hell O Krishna, wisdom alone is his awakening; the ey.es of wisdom alone can rescue him.

sa: अन्तं गत्वा कर्मणां मा प्रजह्याः सत्यं दमं चार्जवमानृशंस्यम्। अश्वमेधं राजसूयं तथज्याः पापस्यान्तं कर्मणो मा पुनर्गाः॥
en: Having got to the end of your deeds, do not however, put truth, self-conduct, candour and humility. You may perform the Ashvamedha and Rajasuya sacrifices, but do not come again near the limits of sinful acts.

sa: यक्ष उवाच को मोदते किमाश्चर्यं कः पन्थाः का च वार्तिका। ममैतांश्चतुरः प्रश्नान् कथयित्वा जलं पिब॥
en: The Yaksha said: Who is happy? What is wonderful? What is the path? And what is the news? Answer these four questions put by me and then let your four dead kinsinen be restored to life.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच प्रियवचनवादी प्रियो भवति विमृशितकार्यकरोऽधिकं जयति। बहुमित्रकरः सुखं वसते यश्च धर्मरतः स गतिं लभते॥
en: Yudhishthira said: A person of agreeable speech becomes dear (to all). He that acts deliberately obtains much. He that has many friends lives happily. And he that is given to virtue attains to (an excellent) state.

sa: तस्मात् सेनाविभागं मे कुरुध्वं नरसत्तमाः। अक्षौहिण्यश्च सप्तैताः समेता विजयाय वै॥
en: Therefore do you, O best among men, make a division of my army; these are the seven Akshauhinis who have assembled for my victory.

sa: पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षं च द्यां चैव पुरुषोत्तमः। मनसैव विशिष्टात्मा नयत्यात्मवशं वशीः॥
en: That foremost men, of a superior soul, can by mere force of his will bring under control the earth, the sky and the heavens.

sa: पटेनाग्नि प्रज्वलितं यथा बाला यथा जडाः। सात्यकेस्तद् वचः श्रुत्वा विदुरोदीर्घदर्शिवान्॥
en: As children and idiots attempt to seize blazing fire by means of their cloths.” Hearing those words of Satyaki Vidura, endued with great foresight,

sa: वयस्यत्वात् तु ते ब्रह्मन्नपराधमिमं क्षमे। नेदृशं तु पुनर्वाच्यं यदि जीवितुमिच्छसि॥
en: For the sake of friendship, O Brahmana, I forgive you for this offence. You must not speak so again, if you wish to live."

sa: इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा वयमुत्थाय सत्वराः॥ सागरक्रमणे मन्त्रं मन्त्रयामः परंतप।
en: Hearing him thus speak, we got up soon and O tormentor of foes, held a consultation together as to how to cross the sea;

sa: सर्वशस्त्रभृतां श्रेष्ठं मेरुं शिखरिणमिव। युधि गाण्डीवधन्वानं को नु युध्येत बुद्धिमान्॥
en: The foremost of the wielder of weapons, that Meru among the mountains, what intelligent man would fight with that wielder of the Gandiva bow.

sa: उवाच चैनं विप्रर्षि विमानं कर्मभिर्जितम्। समुपारोह संसिद्धि प्राप्तोऽसि परमां मुने॥
en: He spoke thus to the Brahmanas. Ascend this car. O Rishis, the result of your acts, you have obtained the fruit of your asceticism.

sa: येऽर्थं संततमासाद्य दीना इव समासते। श्रियं ते समप्रयच्छन्ति द्विषद्भ्यो भरतर्षभ॥
en: Those, who attaining to prosperity behave like the mean-minded contribute to the prosperity of their despisers, O you bull among the race of Bharata.

sa: संस्थाप्य चाश्वान् कौन्तेयः समुद्यम्य च रश्मिभिः। उत्तरं च परिष्वज्य समाश्वासयदर्जुनः॥
en: Then raising the horses up with reins and keeping them in their proper places and embracing Uttara, Arjuna, the son of Kunti, consoled him.

sa: एवं संचिन्तयन्ती सा ददर्शर्तुं यदृच्छया। वीडिता साभवद् बाला कन्याभावे रजस्वला॥
en: While thus musing (within herself) she suddenly perceived that she attained puberty. Having attained maturity during her maidenhood, the girl was covered with shame.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच अहमसम्यर्जुनः पार्थः सभास्तारो युधिष्ठिरः। बल्लवो भीमसेनस्तु पितुस्ते रसपाचकः॥
en: Arjuna said I am Arjuna, the son of Pritha, your father's courtier is Yudhishthira and the clever cook of your father, Ballava, is Bhimasena.

sa: राजानः पार्थिवाः सर्वे प्रोक्षिताः कालधर्मणा। गाण्डीवाग्नि प्रवेक्ष्यन्ति पतङ्गा इव पावकम्॥
en: The kings and the rulers, too, all consecrated by the king of death himself shall enter the Gandiva bow as moths fall on fire.

sa: यदि ह्येते समर्थाः स्युर्मविषस्त्रातुमञ्जसः। न स्म त्रयोदश समाः पार्था दुःखमवाप्नुयुः॥
en: If these had been capable of rescuing my enemies by their might; then the sons of Pritha would not have met with trouble years.

sa: नैव मानुषवद् देवा: प्रवर्तन्ते कदाचन। कामात् क्रोधात् तथा लोभावेषाच्च भरतर्षभ॥
en: Never like men do the gods engage themselves in the work out of desire, wrath, avarice, hatred, O bull among the race of Bharata.

sa: इति द्वैपायनो व्यासो नारदश्च महातपाः। जामदग्न्यश्च रामो नः कथामकथयत् पुरा॥
en: Such was the tale told to us in days of yore by the great devotees Dvaipayana, Vyasa, Narayana and Rama the son of Jamadagna.

sa: पराभवो मा भविष्यत् कुरुदारेषु सर्वशः। एवमुक्ते तु धर्मात्मा ज्येष्ठः पाण्डुसुतस्तदा॥
en: Do not allow great insult to be offered to all the Kuru ladies." Having been thus addressed, the eldest Pandava, who is ever virtuous.

sa: त्रयाणामेव च मतं तत् त्वमेकोऽनुमन्यसे। रामेण चैव शप्तस्य कर्णस्य भरतर्षभ॥
en: The advice of the three persons you alone listen to, O bull among the race of Bharata, viz. Karna, who was cursed by Rama,

sa: युधिष्ठिरे समासक्तां धर्मज्ञे धर्मसंवृताम्। असत्सु दुर्लभां नित्यं सतां चाभिमतां सदा॥
en: Bespeaking his attachment to the pious Yudhishthira, words that are rarely given vent to by the dishonest men and always liked by the honest.

sa: ततस्तौ शक्रमब्रूतां करिष्यावो यदिच्छसि। ताभ्यां च सहितः शक्रो विजिग्ये दैत्यदानवान्॥
en: Then did the two tell Shakra, "we shall do what you wish.” Then aided by them Shakra triumphed over the Daityas and the Danavas.

sa: तद् दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्य माधवस्य सभातले। देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवर्षं पपात च॥
en: Seeing that great wonderful appearance of Madhava in the inside of the Assembly-hall celestial drums were sounded and there was a downpour of flowers.

sa: ददृशुस्ते ध्वजाग्रं वै शुश्रुवुश्च महास्वनम्। दोधूयमानस्य भृशं गाण्डीवस्य च निस्वनम्॥
en: They saw the top of his banner, heard the rattle of his car and the twang of his Gandiva bow, stretched greatly by him.

sa: यदा च कर्णो राजेन्द्र भानुमन्तं दिवाकरम्। स्तौति मध्यन्दिने प्राप्ते प्राञ्जलिः सलिले स्थितः॥ तत्रैनमुपतिष्ठन्ति ब्राह्मणा धनहेतुना। नादेयं तस्य तत्काले किञ्चिदस्ति द्विजातिषु॥
en: O king of kings, when at noon Karna rose from the water and worshipped the author of the day possessed of rays with joined palms, the Brahmanas prayed to him for riches. And at that time there was nothing that he would not bestow on the twice-born ones.

sa: तदेषा लभतां कामं यथाभिलषितं वधूः। अप्रमादश्च कर्तव्यः पुत्रि सत्यवतः पथि॥
en: So, let what my daughter-in-law desires be fulfilled. Daughter, act in such a manner that Satyavana does not neglect his business on the way.

sa: गन्धेन गावः पश्यन्ति वेदैः पश्यन्ति ब्राह्मणाः। चारैः पश्यन्ति राजानश्चक्षुर्ष्यामितरे जनाः॥
en: King see by means of smell, Brahmanas see by means of the Vedas, kings see by means of scouts and other people through eyes.

sa: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं विस्तरेण तपोधन। कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च यद् यदासीद् विचेष्टितम्॥
en: This I desire to hear in detail, O you whose only wealth is devotion, namely the movements respectively of the Kurus and the Pandavas.

sa: यक्ष उवाच किंस्विदेकपदं धर्म्य किंस्विदेकपदं यशः। किंस्विदेकपदं स्वर्णं किंस्विदेकपदं सुखम्॥
en: The Yaksha asked What is the crowning refuge of religion? What of renown? What is the highest refuge of heaven and what of happiness?

sa: निर्मोचने षट् सहस्राणि हत्वा संच्छिद्य पाशान् सहसा क्षुरान्तान्। मुरं हत्वा विनिहत्यौघरक्षौ निर्मोचनं चापि जगाम वीरः॥
en: Having slain six thousand near the city of Nirmochana and having broken sharp-edged arrows suddenly coming on him, having killed Mura and also having killed crowds of Rakshasas, that hero went into the city of Nirmochana.

sa: तं कालं तं मुहूर्तं च प्रतीक्षन्ती नृपात्मजा। यथोक्तं नारदवचश्चिन्तयन्ती सुदुःखिता॥
en: And with a heavy heart, the princess, pondering on the words of Narada (anxiously) awaited the hour and the moment of her husband's death).

sa: केचिन्नौभिर्व्यवस्यन्ति केचिच्च विविधैः प्लवैः। नेति रामस्तु तान् सर्वान् सान्त्वयन् प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: Some proposed to cross by boats and some by various kinds of rafters. But Rama, having consoled them all, said "This will not do.

sa: पुत्रादनन्तरं शिष्य इति धर्मविदो विदुः। एतेनापि निमित्तेन प्रियो द्रोणस्य पाण्डवः॥
en: Persons conversant with virtue say that a disciple is not different from a son. It is for this reason Arjuna is favourite with Drona.

sa: यद्येवं याचतो मार्ग न प्रदास्यति मे भवान्। शरैस्त्वां शोषयिष्यामि दिव्यास्त्रप्रतिमन्त्रितैः॥
en: If you do not grant the passage prayed for, I will dry you up with arrows inspired with mantras and shot from celestials weapons."

sa: त्वयि पुत्रशतं चैव सत्यवाञ्जनयिष्यति। ते चापि सर्वे राजानः क्षत्रियाः पुत्रपौत्रिणः॥
en: And Satyavana will beget on you one hundred sons. And those Kshatriya sons (of you) together with their sons and grandsons will be kings;

sa: न हास्तिनपुरे त्राणं तव पश्यामि किंचन। व्यायामेन परीप्सस्व जीवितं कौरवात्मज॥
en: O Kuru prince, I do not see that by any means you are safe even at Hastinapur. Protect your life by displaying your energy.

sa: खङ्गः कोशान्निःसरति प्रसन्नो हित्वेव जीर्णीमुरगस्त्वचं स्वाम्। ध्वजे वाचो रौद्ररूपा भवन्ति कदा रथो योक्ष्यते ते किरीटिन्॥
en: The polished sword comes out of the scabbard, as a snake does out of its own worn out skin, and near my banners are heard terrific words like these-'O Kiritin, when will your chariot be yoked?'

sa: पूर्वमेतां दिशं गच्छ या पूर्वं परिकीर्तिता। देवतानां हि सांनिध्यमत्र कीर्तितवानसि॥
en: Go to this eastern quarter which you have described first of all and which you have described as lying in the vicinity of virtue.

sa: ततो निपत्य वेगेन कुम्भकर्णं महामनाः॥ शालेन जनिवान् मूर्ध्नि बलेन कपिकुञ्जरः।
en: Then that high-minded king of the monkeys, coming up to Kumbhakarna with great speed struck him furiously on the head with a Sala tree.

sa: एतैर्हि सहितः सर्वैः पाण्डवैः स्वैश्च भारत। अन्यान् विजेष्यसे शत्रूनेष स्वार्थस्तवाखिलः॥
en: United with these and with all the Pandavas, O Bharata, will you win victories over other enemies; this is all to your own advantage.

sa: द्रौपदी क्व च पाञ्चली स्त्रीरत्नमिति विश्रुता। जितानक्षैस्तदा कृष्णा तानेवावगमद् वनम्॥
en: Where is Draupadi, the princess of Panchala, known as a jewel of a female who followed them to woods after their defeat at dice.

sa: एतत् सलिलराजस्यच्छत्रं छत्रगृहे स्थितम्। सर्वतः सलिलं शीतं जीमूत इव वर्षति॥
en: This thing, placed in the umbrella room, is the umbrella of the lord of the waters and always showers cold water like the clouds.

sa: कृत्स्नेयं पृथिवी देवी जरासंधेन धीमता। मागधेन्द्रेण बलिना वशे कृत्वा प्रतापिताः॥
en: The goddess Earth was brought under control by the wise Jarasandha and that mighty Lord of Magadha, who subjugated her and oppressed her people.

sa: स गत्वा पाण्डुपुत्रेण तरसा बाहुशालिना। अनायुधेन वीरेण निहतः किं ततोऽधिकम्॥
en: The son of Pandu, the heroic of long arms, having approached him without any arms, killed him. What can be more (wonderful) than this?

sa: यो धर्ममर्थं कामं च यथाकालं निषेवते। धर्मार्थकामसंयोगं सोऽमुत्रेह च विन्दति॥
en: He, who pursues virtue, worldly good and desire at suitable periods, gets a combination of virtue, worldly good and desire both here and elsewhere.

sa: तत् तेषां वानरेन्द्राणां पपात पवनोद्धतम्। मध्ये सुपीतं पञ्चानां विद्युन्मेघान्तरे यथा॥
en: And like lightning (playing) among the (dark) clouds that beautiful and yellow (cloth) fluttering through the air fell down among those five (dark-coloured monkeys).

sa: अश्मसारमयं नूनं हृदयं ममम दुहृदः। यमौ यदेतौ दृष्ट्वाद्य पतितौ नावदीर्यते॥
en: Surely this vile heart of me is made of the essence of marble, since seeing these twins lying dead today it is not riven.

sa: कारूषकाच राजानः क्षेमधूर्तिश्च वीर्यवान्। काम्बोजा ऋषिका ये च पश्चिमानूपकाश्च ये॥
en: And the kings of the Karusha and the heroic Kshemadhurti and the rulers Kamboja and the Rishika tribes and the races inhabiting the west.

sa: ततः कालेन सा गर्भं सुषुवे वरवर्णिनी। कन्यैव तस्य देवस्य प्रसादादमरप्रभम्॥
en: (And) in time that damsel of excellent complexion by the favour of that god, Surya, was delivered of a son beautiful as a celestials.

sa: अपश्यद् गाण्डिवं तत्र चतुर्भिरपरैः सह॥ तेषां विमुच्यमानानां धनुषामर्कवर्चसाम्। विनिश्चेरुः प्रभा दिव्या ग्रहाणामुदयेष्विव॥ स तेषां रूपमालोक्य भोगिनामिव जृम्भताम्। हृष्टरोमा भयोद्विग्नः क्षणेन समपद्यत॥ संस्पृश्य तानि चापानि भानुमन्ति बृहन्ति च। वैरारिर्जुनं राजन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: He saw there Gandiva along with four other bows. The celestials effulgence of these bows resplendent like the rays of the sun, when got out, appeared like that of the planet at the time of rising. Beholding their forms like sighing snakes he, in time, overwhelmed with fear and the hairs of his body stood on ends. Then touching those huge and mighty lustrous bows Virata's son said to Arjuna. no was

sa: उत्पथे हि वने जाता गृगव्यालनिषेविते। समीपे च श्मशानस्य गहनस्य विशेषतः॥
en: Remote from the road there grows the tree in the forest inhabited by beasts and snakes and it stands beside a dismal cremation ground,

sa: अथ दर्यान्वितो मोहान्न कुर्याद् धृतराष्ट्रजः। अन्येषां प्रेषयित्वा च पश्चादस्मान् समाह्वये॥
en: If the son of Dhritarashtra dose not thus seek peace owing to the ignorance mixed with vanity, summon us after sending word to others.

sa: चोदयामास तस्यार्थे सा रामं विधिचोदिता। रामस्तस्याः प्रियं कुर्वन् धनुरादाय सत्वरः॥ रक्षार्थे लक्ष्मणं न्यस्य प्रययौ मृगलिप्सया।
en: Driven by destiny, Sita sent Rama in pursuit of him. And Rana (too) with a view to please her, soon taking up his bow and instructing Lakshmana to protect her, went in pursuit of that deer.

sa: मा भैष्ट दुःखेन कुजीवितेन नूनं कृतं परलोकेषु पापम्। निगृह्य शत्रून् सुहृदोऽनुगृह्या वासोभिरनेन च वो भरिष्ये॥
en: Do not be sorry for this uncomfortable life; sins must surely have been committed by you in the life before; after destroying my enemies I shall support them with food and clothes and favour my friends.

sa: ततो यथाप्रतिज्ञाभिः प्राविशान् नगरं महत्। अज्ञातचर्यां वत्स्यन्तो राष्ट्र वर्षं त्रयोदशम्॥
en: For the purpose of passing the thirteenth year undiscovered in that kingdom they entered the great city in conformity to their promise (to Duryodhana).

sa: जीवनाशं प्रनष्टानां श्राद्धं कुर्वन्ति मानवाः। अर्थतस्ते मम मृतास्तेषां चाहं जनार्दन॥
en: Virtually they are dead to me and I am the same to them, O Janardana, O Madhava, say this to the virtuous-souled king Yudhishthira.

sa: वृष्ण्यन्धकाः सुमनसो यस्य प्रज्ञामुपासते। आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा यथा बुद्धिं बृहस्पतेः॥
en: The Vrishnis and the Andhakas of honest minds honour his wisdom; as the Adityas, the Vasus and the Rudras do the intelligence of Brihaspati.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच उपप्लव्यादिह क्षत्तरुपायातो जनार्दनः। वृकस्थले निवसति स च प्रातरिहैष्यति॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Kshatriya (Vidura), Janardana has set out from Upaplavya. He is now staying at Vrikasthala; and will come here in the morning.

sa: पराश्रया वासुदेव या जीवति धिगस्तु ताम्। वृत्तेः कार्पण्यलध्याया अप्रतिष्ठेव ज्यायसी॥
en: To a mode of life attended with meanness death even is superior. Say also to Dhananjaya and Vrikodara who are constantly on the alert.

sa: यस्य लोके समो नास्ति कश्चिदन्यो धनुर्धरः। मत्प्रसादात् स बीभत्सुः श्रेयानन्यैर्धनुर्धरैः॥
en: He who is equaled by no bowman in this earth-it is through my grace and favour, is superior to other wielders of the bow.

sa: विग्रहं पाण्डवैः कृत्वा महद् व्यसनमाप्स्यसि॥ द्रौपदी यस्य चाशास्ते विजयं सत्यवादिनी।
en: And fighting with the sons of Pandu will fall into a great trouble. Whose victory is prayed for by that speaker of truth Draupadi,

sa: अर्जुन उवाच कुरूणामद्य सर्वेषां भवान् सुहृदनुत्तमः। सम्बन्धी दयितो नित्यमुभयोः पक्षयोरपि॥
en: Arjuna said You are now the best friend of the Kurus. Being related to both parties by thick ties, you are now their friend.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवस्तुष्टः समभवत् तदा। अवमेने हि दुर्बुद्धिर्मनुष्यान् पुरुषादकः॥
en: Markandeya said : Thus accosted the ten headed Ravana was greatly delighted; on account of his perverted understanding, the man-eating (demon) disregarded human beings.

sa: यतश्च जातसंरम्भो न च शत्रुवशं गतः॥ ततो युधिष्ठिरो मत्स्यं पुनरेवाभ्यभाषत।
en: Through you, afflicted with fear I did not pass into the hands of the enemies." Yudhishthira then again said to the king of Matsya's.

sa: वसिष्ठं वामदेवं च जाबालिमथ कश्यपम्। द्विजांश्च सर्वप्रवरानश्वमेधपुरस्कृतान्॥ एतान्सर्वान्समानीय मन्त्रयित्वा च लक्ष्मण। हयं लक्षणसंपन्नं विमोक्ष्यामि समाधिना॥
en: O Laksmana, having invited Vasistha, the foremost of twice-born ones, conversant with all the rites of Aśvamedha, Vāmadeva, Jābāli, and Kaśyapa and consulted with them duly I shall set free a horse gifted with all marks.

sa: ऐक्ष्वाकी जनयामास सुहोत्रात् पृथिवीपतेः। अजमीढं सुमीढं च पुरुमीढं च भारत॥
en: O descendent of the Bharata race, the lord of the earth Suhotra begot on his wife, Aikshvaki three sons, namely Ajamidha, Sumidha and Purumidha.

sa: पूजयित्वा ततो द्रोणं विधिवत् स निषादजः। निवेद्य शिष्यमात्मानं तस्थौ प्राञ्जलिरग्रतः॥
en: The son of Nishada worshipped Drona in the due form and represented himself as his pupil. He then stood before him with joined hands.

sa: विक्षरो बलवीरौ च वृत्रश्चैव महासुरः। कालायाः प्रथिताः पुत्राः कालकल्पा प्रहारिणः।३४।
en: (They were) Vikshara, Bala, Vira and the great Asura Vritra. The sons of Kala were like Yama himself, all the slayers of their enemies.

sa: वयं च शक्तिसम्पन्ना अकाले त्वामधृष्णुम्। अशक्ता हि रणे क्रूरयुष्मानन्ति मानवाः॥
en: We are endued with prowess, we care not when, we disturb you. O wicked being, those men that are incapable (of fighting) worship you.

sa: विप्रोषिता दीर्घकालमेते चापि नरर्षभाः। उत्सुका नगरं द्रष्टुं भविष्यन्ति तथा पृथा॥
en: These best of men (the Pandavas) are long absent (from Hastinapur). They and Pritha (Kunti) must be very eager to see their own city.

sa: सैन्ये च हतभूयिष्ठे किंचिच्छिष्टे सुयोधनः। ह्रदं प्रविश्य यत्रासौ संस्तभ्यापो व्यवस्थितः॥
en: When only a small remnant of his troops remained alive, Suyodhana retired in to a lake and there creating room for himself, lay hidden.

sa: संतर्पयित्वा ज्वलनं ब्राह्मणान् स्वस्त वाच्य च। वारयामास सर्वाणि वादित्राणि समन्ततः॥
en: Gratifying Agni and making the Brahmanas utter the formula of benediction, he stopped all the musical instruments (that were then being played) all around.

sa: प्रत्यक्षं ते यथा शापो द्विजाभ्यां मयि पातितः।।१४ नरश्रेष्ठ सरोषाभ्यामपराधेऽपि तादृशे।
en: You have seen, with your own eyes, the curse that the Brāhmaṇas have given me being enraged for a very trifling folly of mine.

sa: तत्रावसन् बहून् कालान् भारता दुर्गमाश्रिताः। तेषां निवसतां तत्र सहस्रं परिवत्सरान्॥
en: There lived the Bharatas within their fort for many years; and thus full one thousand years: and thus full one thousand years passed away.

sa: ययातेस्त्वेव भोजानां विस्तरो गुणतो महान्। भजतेऽद्य महाराज विस्तरं स चतुर्दिशम्॥
en: O great king, the descendants of Yayati and the Bhoja are also great in birth number and accomplishments. They are scattered in all directions.

sa: कुरूणामनयाच्चापि पृथिवी न भविष्यति। गच्छ त्वं योगमास्थाय युक्ता वस तपोवने॥
en: By the evil doings of the Kurus the world will be destroyed; (therefore) go into the forest of asceticism, devoting yourself to Yoga meditation.

sa: यत्र राजा महाप्राज्ञः सर्वधर्मभृतां वरः। राज्ञां तानि शरीराणि दाहयामास शास्त्रतः॥
en: The cremation of the chiefs and potentates by king Yudhishthira, the greatly wise and the foremost of all virtuous men, according to due rites.

sa: वसव ऊचुः जातान् कुमारान् स्वानप्सु प्रक्षेप्तुं वै त्वमर्हसि। यथा न चिरकालं नो निष्कृतिं स्यात् त्रिलोकगे॥
en: The Vasus said : O lady of three courses (celestial, terrestrial and subterranean), you should throw your children into water just after their birth, so that we may not have to live for long on earth.

sa: विज्ञानेष्वपि चास्त्राणां सौष्ठवे च महाबलः। क्रियास्वपि च सर्वासु विशेषानभ्यशिक्षयत्॥ आगमे च प्रयोगे च चक्रे तुल्यमिवात्मना। तुतोष पुत्रं सौभद्रं प्रेक्षमाणो धनंजयः॥
en: That powerful boy (Abhimanyu) became equal to his father in counteracting the weapons hurled upon him, in great lightness of hands, in fleetness of inotion, forward and backward and in traversing and wheeling. Seeing his son, the son of Subhadra, (so skillful in arms), Dhananjaya became exceedingly happy.

sa: अर्थवानेष देशो हि धनरत्नादिभिर्युतः। वसुपूर्णा च वसुधा वस चेदिषु चेदिप॥
en: O king of Chedi, this Chedi, your kingdom, is full of riches, gems and precious stones. It contains much mineral wealth. You dwell there.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा नृपस्तत्र सुतं राजा महायशाः। श्वभ्रं जगाम सुकृतं वासाय पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: O foremost of men, having given this advice to his son, the highly illustrious king Nțga proceeded to live in the sweet fragrant den.

sa: पुरोहितमते तिष्ठेद् य इच्छेद् भूतिमात्मनः। प्राप्तुं वसुमती सर्वां सर्वशः सागराम्बराम्॥
en: He, who desires his own prosperity, should ever be guided by his priest; he may then acquire the whole earth attired in her oceancloth.

sa: अह्ना यदेनः क्रियते इन्द्रियैर्मनसापि वा। ज्ञानादज्ञानतो वापि प्रकरोति नरश्च यत्॥
en: The sins that are committed daily by our senses and by our mind and those that are committed knowingly or unknowingly by any man.

sa: मानुषेषु महाभागे न त्वेवान्येषु जन्तुषु॥ तदाप्रभृति मर्यादा स्थितेयमिति नः श्रुतम्।
en: O greatly illustrious lady, we have heard that the present practice among men and women dates from that day but not among other animals.

sa: इत्याख्यानं मयास्तीकं यथावत्तव कीर्तितम्। यत्कीर्तयित्वा सर्पेभ्यो न भयं विद्यते क्वचित्॥
en: Thus have I narrated to you the history of Astika exactly as it happened, a history, which if narrated, dispels all fear of snakes.

sa: न हि केवलशौर्येण तापत्याभिजनेन च। जयेदब्राह्मणः कश्चिद् भूमि भूमिपतिः क्वचित्॥
en: O descendant of Tapati, a king, who is without a Brahmana, can never acquire any land by his bravery or nobility of birth only.

sa: न चैतन्नः प्रियं तात यदिदं कर्तुमिच्छसि। नियच्छेदं मनः पापात् सर्वलोकपराभवात्॥
en: O child, that which you desire to do is not pleasing to us. Therefore, control your mind and abstain from overcoming the whole world.

sa: रन्वागतं धर्मराजं वनस्थम्। भिक्षाभुजां ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनां तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Yudhishthira had been followed into wilderness by Snatakas and by holy Brahmanas.

sa: एवं सर्वा दिशो दैत्यौ जित्वा क्रूरेण कर्मणा। निःसप्नौ कुरुक्षेत्रे निवेशमभिचक्रतुः॥
en: Thus subjugating all the points of heaven by cruel acts, the Danavas lived at Kurukshetra having not a single rival (in all the earth).

sa: अग्निकार्यं स कृत्वा तु नागराजसुतां तदा। प्रहसन्निव कौन्तेय इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having performed the sacrificial rites me for the fire, the son of Kunti (Arjuna) spoke thus smilingly to the daughter of the Naga king.

sa: अरिहः खल्वाङ्गीमुपयेमे। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे महाभौमः।।
en: Ariha married Angi and she gave birth to a son, named Mahabhauma.

sa: तथा तु नियतात्मानं तं नृपं मुनिसत्तमः। आबभाषे स धर्मात्मा तस्यैवार्थचिकीर्षया॥
en: As soon as that virtuous-minded and the best of Rishis knew this, he became desirous of benefiting the king and gave him his assurances.

sa: तत्र तत्र च विप्रेन्द्रान् नियतान् संशितव्रतान्। जपहोमपरान् विप्रान् ददर्श परवीरहा॥
en: The destroyer of the enemy's army, (Dushyanta), saw around him innumerable learned Brahmanas of rigid vows who were all engaged in japa and homa.

sa: ऋषींश्च ब्रह्मचर्येण संतत्या च पितामहान्। अपहृत्य गुरुं भारं पितॄणां संशितव्रतः॥
en: He pleased the Rishis by his Brahmacharya and his ancestors by begetting offspring. Thus discharging the heavy debt that he owed to his ancestors.

sa: तद् वनं नन्दनप्रख्यमासाद्य मनुजेश्वरः। क्षुत्पिपासे जहौ राजा मुदं चावाप पुष्कलाम्॥
en: The king forgot his hunger and thirst and derived infinite pleasure as soon as he entered that forest, like Nandana, (the garden of Indra.)

sa: एवमुक्त्वा ययातिस्तु स्मृत्वा काव्यं महातपाः। संक्रामयामास जरां तदा पूरौ महात्मनि॥
en: Having said this, Yayati remembered the great ascetic, the son of Kavi (Shukra) and transferred his decrepitude to the body of the high-souled Puru.

sa: वेदवेदाङ्गविद्वान् स तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषः। ततः पितृनियुक्तात्मा पुत्रलोभान्महायशाः॥ शारद्वतीं ततो भार्यां कृपी द्रोणोऽन्वविन्दत। अग्निहोत्रे च धर्मे च दमे च सततं रताम्॥
en: Being well-versed in the Vedas and Vedangas and having burnt all his sins by asceticism, the greatly illustrious Drona, obedient to the injunctions of his father and moved by the desire of offspring, married Kripi, the daughter of Sharadvana, ever engaged in Agnihotra, in piety and in penances.

sa: लोकानां स्वस्ति चैवं स्यात्कृते कर्मणि च त्वया। एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं लवणस्य दुरात्मनः॥ शूलस्य च बलं घोरमप्रमेयं नरर्षभ। विनाशश्चैव मांधातुर्यत्नेनाभूच्च पार्थिव ॥
en: People shall be at ease if you can bring about the destruction of Lavaņa. O foremost of men, I shall then describe to you the incomparable and dreadful prowess of the vicious-souled Lavaņa and his dart. O king, with great exertions did Lavaņa slay Māndhāta and not easily.

sa: त्वं मे बहुमतो राम गुणैर्बहुभिरुत्तमैः। अतिथिः पूजनीयश्च मम राजन्हृदि स्थितः॥
en: O Rāma, I love you because you are gifted with many qualities. O king, you are my worshipful guest. I was thinking of you.

sa: तामनुज्ञाय वार्ष्णेयः प्रतिनन्द्य च भामिनीम्। ददर्शानन्तरं कृष्णां धौम्यं चापि जनार्दनः॥
en: Bidding her farewell and uttering blessings on that beautiful lady, the hero of the Vrishni race Janardana (Krishna) then saw Krishna (Draupadi) and Dhananjaya.

sa: पतिहि देवता नार्याः पतिर्बन्धुः पतिर्गुरुः॥ प्राणैरपि प्रियं तस्माद्भर्तुः कार्य विशेषतः।
en: Husband is a woman's god-her friend and spiritual guide. It is proper therefore to wok out husband's well-being even at the sacrifice of life.

sa: ब्राह्यं वेदमधीयाना वेदाङ्गानि च सर्वशः। नीतिशास्त्रं च सर्वज्ञा ददृशुस्ते पितामहम्॥
en: They studied the Brahma (Rik) and the Vedangas and all other sciences of morals. (When they were thus engaged), they saw their grandfather (Vyasa).

sa: स तैः प्राञ्जलिभिः सर्वैस्तथेत्युक्तो नराधिप। जगाम भगवान् व्यासो यथागतमृषिः प्रभुः॥
en: O king, they all said with joined hands, "Be it so." (Thereupon) the illustrious lord, the Rishi Vyasa, went away from whence he came.

sa: एषा सभा मया राजन् दृष्टा पुष्करमालिनी। शतक्रतोर्महाबाहो याम्यामपि सभां शृणु॥
en: O king, I have seen this Sabha, named Pushkaramalini of the deity of one thousand sacrifices (Indra). Here about the assembly-hall of Yama. now

sa: पुत्रं जनय सुश्रोणि धाम क्षत्रियतेजसाम्। लब्धः प्रसादो देवेन्द्रात् तभाह्वय शुचिस्मिते॥
en: O lady of beautiful thighs, O lady of sweet smiles, raise up a son. Call the lord of the celestials, I have gratified him.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्त्वा सहितास्ते तु राजानमुपचक्रमुः। नाभ्यनन्दत तान् राजा देवयान्यास्तदान्तिके॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said this, they came to the king to clasp his knees. But the king dared not caress them before Devayani.

sa: गत्वा त्रिभुवन श्रेष्ठं पितामहमुवाच ह। भगवन्ब्रह्मलोकोऽयं क्षुत्पिपासाविवर्जितः॥ कस्यायं कर्मणः पाकः क्षुत्पिपासानुगो ह्यहम्। आहारः कश्च मे देव तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥
en: There upon approaching the patriarch Brahma, the lord of three worlds, I said: O lord, here there is no hunger or thirst; still why have I been brought to their control? Of what iniquity of mine is this fruit? O deity, tell me upon what I shall live.

sa: विप्रशापाभिभूते च क्षीणायुषि नराधिपे। घटमानस्य ते विप्र सिद्धिः संशयिता भवेत्॥
en: O Brahmana, your success is doubtful, for that king is affected with a Brahmana's curse and the period of his life is also shortened.

sa: उवाच च महाप्राज्ञस्तं राजानं महामुनिः। गच्छ राजन् कृतार्थोऽसि निवर्तस्व नराधिप॥
en: That greatly learned Rishi spoke thus to the king, “O king, go, your wish is fulfilled. O king, desist from going to the forest."

sa: व्यास उवाच ततस्तु ते पूर्वजदेववाक्यं श्रुत्वा जग्मुर्यत्र देवा यजन्ते। समासीनास्ते समेता महाबला भागीरथ्यां ददृशुः पुण्डरीकम्॥
en: Vyasa said : Having heard these words of the first born deity, the greatly strong (celestials) went (to the place of sacrifice) and when they all assembled there, they saw a (golden) lotus in the Bhagirathi.

sa: ईशा वै सर्वलोकस्य वसवस्ते च वै कथम्। मानुषेषूदपद्यन्त तन्ममाचक्ष्व जाह्नवि॥
en: Why also the lord of the three worlds, the Vasus, were condemned to be born among men? O daughter of Jahnu, tell me all.

sa: इत्यवेक्ष्य महाप्राज्ञः कामानां फल्गुतां नृप। समाधाय मनो बुद्ध्या प्रत्यगृह्णाजरां सुतात्॥
en: The greatly wise king, seeing this and having been satisfied that one's desires are never satiated, received back his old age from his son.

sa: गुरोर्हि वचनं प्राहुर्धर्म्य धर्मसत्तम। गुरूणां चैव सर्वेषां माता परमको गुरुः॥
en: O foremost of all men learned in the precepts of virtue, it is a cardinal virtue. Of all superiors the mother is the foremost.

sa: इन्द्रे गते तु राजेन्द्र तक्षको भयमोहितः। मन्त्रशक्त्या पावकार्चिः समीपमवशो गतः॥
en: On the departure of Indra, the king of snakes, Takshaka, insensible with fear, was brought near the sacrificial fire by virtue of the Mantras.

sa: ततोऽभ्यगच्छत् सहसा मन्दपालोऽपि भारत। अथ ते सर्व एवैनं नाभ्यनन्दंस्तदा सुताः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, just at that very time, Mandapala suddenly arrived there, but none of his sons expressed any joy on seeing him.

sa: पप्रच्छ चैनं धर्मात्मा यथा प्रदुताः पुरात्। स तस्मै सर्वमाचख्यावानुपूर्वेण पाण्डवः॥
en: The virtuous minded (king) asked how they (the Pandavas) had escaped from the city (of Varanavata). The Pandava (Yudhishthira) narrated it all in detail.

sa: गण: क्रोधवशो नाम यस्ते राजप्रकीर्तितः। तत: संजज्ञिरे वीराः क्षिताविह नराधिपाः॥
en: O king, many heroic monarchs, were born on earth form the race of Asuras, called Krodhavasha, of whom I have already spoken to you.

sa: सखेति कृत्वा तु सखे पृष्टो वक्ष्याम्यहं त्वया। न ह्यात्मस्तवसंयुक्तं वक्तव्यमनिमित्ततः॥
en: O friend, as we are now made friends and as you ask me, I will tell you, although selfpraise without reason is always improper.

sa: भगवंस्तद्वनं घोरं तपस्तप्यति यत्र सः। श्वेतो वैदर्भको राजा कथं तदमृगद्विजम्॥
en: O Brahmana, why was that dense forest, in which the king Sveta of Vidarbha used to perform hard penances, divested of birds and animals?

sa: पाञ्चालराजेन सुता निसृष्टा स्वधर्मदृष्टेन यथा न कामात्। प्रदिष्टशुल्का द्रुपदेन राज्ञा सा तेन वीरेण तथानुवृत्ता॥ न तत्र वर्णेषु कृता विवक्षा न चापि शीले न कुले न गोत्रे। कृतेन सज्येन हि कार्मुकेण विद्धन लक्ष्येण हि सा विसृष्टा॥
en: Yudhishthira said: By fixing a special kind of dower the Panchala king, has given away his daughter according to the practice of his order. He has not done it freely. Therefore, he has nothing to say in regard to the race, tribe, family and character of him who has performed the feat. This hero has won the princess by satisfying the demand of the king Drupada. All his queries have been answered by the stringing of the bow and the shooting down the mark.

sa: तिष्ठन्तं राजसमितौ पुरंदरमिवापरम्। तं दृष्ट्वा सानवद्यागी कुन्तिभोजसुता शुभा॥ पाण्डुं नरवरं रङ्गे हृदयेनाकुलाभवत्। ततः कामपरीताङ्गी सकृत्प्रचलमानसा॥
en: He (Pandu) looked among the kings as the second Indra. In the assembly that best of men, Pandu, having seen the maiden of faultless feature, the amiable daughter of Kuntibhoja, became very much agitated in mind.

sa: देवयान्युवाच निष्कृतिर्मेऽस्तु वा मास्तु शृणुष्वावहितो मम॥ शर्मिष्ठया यदुक्तास्मि दुहिता वृषपर्वणः। सत्यं किलैतत् सा प्राह दैत्यानामसि गायनः॥ एवं हि मे कथयति शर्मिष्ठा वार्षपर्वणी। वचनं तीक्ष्णपरुषं क्रोधरक्तेक्षणा भृशम्॥ स्तुवतो दुहिता नित्यं याचत: प्रतिगृह्णतः। अहं तु स्तूयमानस्य ददतोऽप्रतिगृह्णतः॥
en: Devayani said: Be it punishment of my fault or not (O father), hear all that the daughter of Vrishaparva, Sharmishtha, had said to me. She has said, (I say) truly, that you are a Bandi (hired chanter) of the Asura king. Even thus did Sharmishtha, the daughter of Vrishaparva, speak. These cruel and piercing words, with her eyes red (with anger). (She said), “You are the daughter of one who always chants the praise of others for hire and who always asks for charity.

sa: नि:संशयं क्षत्रियपुङ्गवास्ते यथा हि युद्धं कथयन्ति राजन्। आशा हि नो व्यक्तमियं समृद्धा मुक्तान् हि पार्थाञ्छृणुमोऽग्निदाहात्॥
en: O king, there is no doubt that they are foremost of Kshatriyas, their conversations being on all military subjects. Our hope has been fulfilled. We have heard that the sons of Pritha escaped from the conflagration.

sa: वज्रस्य च करिष्यामि तवैव च शतक्रतो। एतत्पनं त्यजाम्येकं यस्यान्तं नोपलप्स्यसे॥
en: I shall respect the thunder-bolt and you also, O Indra, I cast a feather of mine, end of which even you will never find.

sa: सदा संरब्धनयनौ सदा चानिमिषेक्षणौ। तयोरेकोऽपि यं पश्येत् स तूर्णं भस्मसाद्भवेत्॥
en: Their eyes were winkless and always inflamed with anger. He who was even seen by any of the two was instantly reduced to ashes.

sa: साध्याः प्राची सगन्धर्वा वसवो दक्षिणां दिशम्। प्रजग्मुः सहिता रुद्राः पतगेन्द्रप्रधर्षिताः॥
en: Thus overcome by the king of birds, the Sadhyas fled with the Gandharvas towards the east, the Vasus with the Rudras towards the south,

sa: सौतिरुवाच इत्युक्त्वा गरुडं सोऽथ माङ्गल्यमकरोत्तदा॥
en: Sauti said : Having said this to Garuda, he blessed him, saying,

sa: तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना तपः कुर्यामनुत्तमम्। तपो हि परमं श्रेयः संमोहमितरत्सुखम्॥
en: Thereupon he determined upon performing a hard penance. He considered asceticism as the best of all and regarded all other things as mere illusions.

sa: गण्डकी च महाशोणं सदानीरां तथैव च। एकपर्वतके नद्यः क्रमेणैत्याव्रजन्त ते॥
en: They (finally) crossed the (rivers) Gandaki, the Sadanira and the Ekaparavata and others rivers, all these (rivers) taking either rise from the same mountain.

sa: ततो नरा विनिष्क्रान्ता नगरात् कल्यमेव तु। ददृशुनिहतं भूमौ राक्षसं रुधिरोक्षितम्॥
en: The next morning the inhabitants of the town, in coming out, saw the Rakshasas lying dead on the ground, his body covered with blood.

sa: भगवानपि तं दृष्ट्वा कुशलं प्रतिवेद्य च। सदस्यैः पूजितः सर्वैः सदस्यान्प्रत्यपूजयत्॥
en: The illustrious Rishi, also looked (graciously) at him and asked him about his welfare. He then worshipped the Sadasyas who had already worshipped him.

sa: गृहेषु कुरुमुख्यानां पौराणां च नराधिप। दीयतां भुज्यतां चेति वाचोऽश्रूयन्त सर्वशः॥
en: O king, in the house of the chief Kurus and in those of the people, "Give” “Eat” were the words that were constantly heard.

sa: पितृदेवनिवासेषु संतापश्चाप्यजायत। भूतसङ्घाश्च बहवो दीनाश्चनुर्महास्वनम्॥
en: Everywhere they were afflicted with great heat. Innumerable creatures yelled in pain.

sa: शक्रः साक्षाद्वज्रपाणिर्यथेह त्राता लोकेऽस्मिंस्त्वं तथेह प्रजानाम्। मतस्त्वं नः पुरुषेन्द्रह लोके न च त्वदन्यो भूपतिरस्ति जज्ञे॥
en: You are protector of all creatures in this world, like Indra himself, thunderbolt in hand. There is no man in this world so great as you. There is no king who is your equal in sacrifices.

sa: वाहनानि प्रहृष्टानि मुदिता मृगपक्षिणः। गन्धवन्ति च माल्यानि रसवन्ति फलानि च।॥
en: The beasts of burdens were happy and the deer and the birds were exceedingly glad. The flowers became fragrant and the fruits became sweet.

sa: न च विप्रेष्वधीकारो विद्यते वरणं प्रति। स्वयंवरः क्षत्रियाणामितीयं प्रथिता श्रुतिः॥
en: The Shruti says that the Svaimvara is for the Kshatriyas; the Brahmanas have no claim in a selection of husband (by a Kshatriyas lady).

sa: सर्वे त्वतिरथाः शूराः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः। सर्वे वेदविदश्चैव राजञ्च्छास्त्रे च पारगा॥
en: They were all heroes, great car-warriors and learned in the use of arms. They were also well-versed in the Vedas and experts in statesmanship

sa: यत्रांशा वः करिष्यन्ति कर्मवीरनिषूदनम्। नरनारायणाभ्यां तु स संग्रामो विना कृतः॥
en: In which your incarnations will kill innumerable heroes. And in the fight in which Nara and Narayana (Arjuna and Krishna) will not be present,

sa: बालः प्रविश्य च व्यूहमभेद्यं विचरिष्यति। महारथानां वीराणां कदनं च करिष्यति॥
en: The boy will enter into that impenetrable Vyuha and will walk about the place. He will defeat and kill many heroes and great carwarriors.

sa: तीर्थानि शोधयित्वा तु तथानुज्ञाय ताः प्रभुः। चित्राङ्गदां पुनर्द्रष्टुं मणिपूरं पुनर्ययौ॥
en: Making safe those Tirthas and giving them (Apsaras) leave to go away, that lord (Arjuna) went again to Manipur to see Chitrangada once more,

sa: कर्दमस्त्वब्रवीद्वाक्यं सुतार्थं परमं हितम्। द्विजाः शृणुत मद्वाक्यं यच्छ्रेयः पार्थिवस्य हि॥
en: For the welfare of his son, the patriarch Kardama said: Hear, O twice-born ones, how the well-being of the king Ila may be secured.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतेन त्वपराधेन शापात् तस्य महात्मनः। धर्मो विदुररूपेण शूद्रयोनावजायत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Being cursed by that illustrious man for this fault, Dharma was born as Vidura in the womb of a Shudra woman.

sa: स्वयमागाच्छमं कर्तुं नगरं नागसाह्वयम्। प्रत्याख्यानं च कृष्णस्य राज्ञा दुर्योधनेन वै॥
en: Went himself to Hastinapur, the capital of the Kurus. (It then relates) the rejection of the peaceful offer of Krishna by the king Duryodhana.

sa: ते वयं मृगयाशीलाश्चराम वसुधामिमाम्। तथा नो विदिता मार्गा भविष्यन्ति पलायताम्॥
en: Let us lead a life of hunting, wandering over the earth. We shall then be aware of all the paths that exist for escape.

sa: कच्चिद् बलेनानुगताः समानि विषमाणि च। पुराणि चौरान निघ्नन्तश्चरन्ति विषये तव॥
en: Are the thieves and the robbers that steal in your city and loot your towns pursued by your soldiers over even and uneven grounds?

sa: असृक्चन्दनदिग्धाङ्गं चारुपत्रं पतत्रिणम्। दानवेन्द्राचलेन्द्राणामसुराणां च दारुणम्॥ तं दीप्तमिव कालाग्निं युगान्ते समुपस्थितम्। दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि भूतानि परित्रासमुपागमन्॥
en: It was pasted with red sandal resembling blood and its feathers were beautiful. Beholding that dart like to the fire of dissolution, and dreadful to lords of Dānavas, mountains and Asuras, the creatures were greatly terrified.

sa: राज्ञा प्रतिष्ठितो धर्मो धर्मात्स्वर्गः प्रतिष्ठितः। राज्ञो यज्ञक्रियाः सर्वा यज्ञाद्देवाः प्रतिष्ठिता॥
en: The king establishes dharma, and by dharma, one gains the kingdom of heaven. The king protects all sacrifices and the sacrifices please the celestials;

sa: न ते मृत्युः प्रभविता यावजीवितुमिच्छसि। त्वत्तो ह्यनुज्ञां सम्प्राप्य मृत्युः प्रभवितानघ॥
en: He said, "O my sinless son! death will have no effect untill you wish to live. Death can influence you only after your permission.

sa: रक्षते दानवांस्तत्र न स रक्षत्यदानवान्। तमाराधयितुं शक्तो भवान् पूर्ववयाः कविम्॥
en: He always protects the Danavas, but never the celestials, their opponents. You are younger than he and you are, therefore, able to revere him.

sa: सा हि गत्वाऽऽश्रमं तस्य रमणीयं शरद्वतः। धनुर्बाणधरं बाला लोभयामास गौतमम्॥
en: She went to the charming hermitage of Sharadvata; and that damsel began there to tempt the son of Gautama (sitting) with bows and arrows.

sa: इयं मधुपुरी रम्या मधुरा देवनिर्मिता। निवेशं प्राप्नुयाच्छीघ्रमेष मेऽस्तु वरः परः॥
en: Let this picturesque and charming city of Madhu, built by the celestials, by my capital; this is the only excellent boon I can beg.

sa: अथ द्रोणो महेष्वासो दशभिः शिनिपुङ्गवम्। अविध्यत् त्वरितं क्रुद्धः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः॥
en: Then the enraged Drona that best of all wielders of weapons, quickly pierced that foremost of the descendants of Shini with ten sharp arrows.

sa: ततः पक्षः प्रपक्षश्च शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः। तदा सशस्त्राः कुरवो भीममभ्यद्रवन् रणे॥
en: Then one and the other wing of the army and Shakuni, the son of Subala and the Kauravas well-armed fell upon Bhima in battle.

sa: बलवन्तश्च दाशार्हा बहवश्च विशाम्पते। यतः कृष्णस्ततः सर्वे यतः कृष्णस्ततो जयः॥
en: O king, the Dasharahas are numerous and powerful. They will be all there where Krishna will be. Where Krishna is, victory is certainly there.

sa: स मृद्गन् पुष्पितांश्चैव फलितांश्च वनस्पतीन्। अवरुज्य ययौ गुल्मान् पथस्तस्य समीपजान्॥
en: He proceeded on, breaking the kings of the forest (big trees) and the plants with their flowers and fruits that stood on his way.

sa: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना। करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः॥
en: Knowledge, the Object of knowledge and the Knower, from the threefold impulse of action.. Instrument. Action and Agent from the threefold complements of action.

sa: सा वै वसुमतीं तत्र पश्यन्ती सुमनोरमाम्। वनस्पतीन् विचिन्वन्ती विजहार सखीवृता॥
en: Accompanied by her maids, she began to sport there, seeing the beautiful scenery and looking at the large trees that stood in the forest.

sa: नैतच्छकोमि संसोढुमाह्वान पुरुषर्षभ। सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि हतान् विद्धि परान् युधि॥
en: O foremost of men, I cannot brook this challenge; I do tell you truly, know these hostile heroes to be already slain in battle.

sa: श्रूयतां चापरं गुह्यं रहस्यं धर्मसंहितम्। श्रद्दधानेन कर्तव्यं गुरूणां वचनं सदा॥
en: Listen now to another mystery unknown to all, about Religion. One should having faith, always do the command of his preceptor and other elders.

sa: विमानान्यनुरूपाणि कामभोग्यानि गालव। अत्र ते ऋषयः सप्त देवी चारुन्धती तथा॥
en: Have their abodes resembling the heaven and replete with all objects of enjoyment; and here live the seven Rishis and also the Goddess Arundhati.

sa: चतुर्धा जन्म इत्येतद् भूतग्रामस्य लक्ष्यते। अपराण्यथ भूतानि खेचराणि तथैव च॥
en: Thus the birth of all living creatures is of four kinds. Now, there are other inferior beings and likewise those which range the sky.

sa: तथा चरन्ती पाञ्चाली सुदेष्णाया निवेशने। तां देवीं तोषयामास तथा चान्त:पुरस्त्रियः॥
en: Conducting herself in this way in Sudeshna's apartments the daughter of Panchala pleased that lady as well as the other women of the harem.

sa: तेषामिष्टं हरन्त्येते निघ्नन्ति च महद्धविः। स्पर्धया हव्यवाहानां निघ्नन्त्येते हरन्ति च॥
en: They frustrate their objects and spoil their oblations of Ghee; they do this only to spite the sacred fires carrying oblations to the celestials.

sa: उभे पूर्वापरे संध्ये नित्यं पश्यामि भारत। उदयास्तमने सूर्य कबन्धैः परिवारितम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, in both the twilights, morning and evening, I daily see the sun covered by headless trunks when rising or setting.

sa: प्रताप्य पृथिवीं सर्वां रश्मिमानिव तेजसा। सोऽयं राज्ञो विराटस्य सभास्तारो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Having dazzled, like the sun, the whole of this earth with his power, even that king Yudhishthira remains as a courtier of king Virata.

sa: ज्ञानेन हि यदा जन्तुरज्ञानप्रभवं तमः। व्यपोहति तदा ब्रह्म प्रकाशति सनातनम्॥
en: When Individual Soul succeeds in removing by means of Knowledge the Darkness which covers him in consequence of Ignorance, then immutable Brahma becomes manifest.

sa: हते सुदक्षिणे राजन् वीरे चैव श्रुतायुधे। जवेनाभ्यद्रवन् पार्थं कुपिताः सैनिकास्तव॥
en: Sanjaya said When king Sudakshina and the heroic Shrutayudha had been slain, your warriors inflamed with wrath, furiously rushed against the son of Pritha.

sa: स तेन सहितस्तस्थावरुणेन यथा रविः॥ संसक्त इव चाभ्रेण यथाद्रिमहता महान्।
en: Accompanied by that charioteer he came like the sun accompanied by his charioteer Arjuna (dawn). Looking like a high mountain enveloped in cloudy masses.

sa: शकुनि दशभिर्विद्ध्वा चतुर्भिश्चास्य वाजिनः। छत्रं ध्वजं धनुश्चास्य च्छित्त्वा सिंह इवानदत्॥
en: Struck Shakuni with ten arrows and his horses with four. Then cutting off his umbrella and standard and bow, he roared like a lion.

sa: भवत्येव हि मे सूत बुद्धिर्दोषानुदर्शिनी। दुर्योधनं समासाद्य पुनः सा परिवर्तते॥
en: My understanding is capable, O Suta, of finding out the disadvantage of a particular act but when I approach Duryodhana my understanding fails me.

sa: एष सूर्य इवाम्भोदैश्छन्नः पार्थो न दृश्यते। एतदन्तोऽर्जुनः शल्य निमग्नो योधसागरे॥
en: Like the sun covered by cloud Partha is no longer visible. Plunged into the deep of warriors O Shalya, Partha is sure to die."

sa: संजय उवाच ततः परानीकसहं व्यूहमप्रतिमं कृतम्। समीक्ष्य कर्णः पार्थनां धृष्टद्युम्मभिरक्षितम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereupon beholding that unrivalled arrangement of the army of Partha protected by Dhristadyumna who was capable of resisting all hostile armies Karna.

sa: ययातिरुवाच दातव्यं याचमानेभ्य इति मे व्रतमाहितम्। त्वं च याचसि मां कामं ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते॥
en: Yayati said : It is one of my strict vows no doubt that I should grant what is asked of me. You ask me (to grant you a favour). Therefore, tell me what should I do?

sa: भीमसेनं तु युध्यन्तं भारद्वाजरथं प्रति। स्वयं दुर्योधनो राजा प्रत्यविध्यच्छितैः शरैः॥
en: King Duryodhana himself pierced with keen arrows Bhimasena who was fighting his way, through your army, towards the car of the son of Bharadvaja.

sa: सात्यकिश्चापि विरथः कं समारूढवान् रथम्। चक्ररक्षौ च पाञ्चाल्यौ तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: And on what cars the carless Satyaki and the two Panchala princes, the protectors of (Arjuna's) car-wheels (respectively) mounted, relate to me, O Sanjaya.

sa: अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य तेषां राजा प्रतर्दनः। जघान तान् महातेजा वज्रानलसमैः शरैः॥
en: Baffling their weapons with his own, prince Pratarddana gifted with great energy killed them all with arrows that resembled the thunder bolt of Indra.

sa: सरथः स तु संतीर्य गङ्गामाशु पराक्रमी। प्रययौ वीतहव्यानां पुरी परपुरंजयः॥
en: Gifted with great prowess Pratarddana, that subjugator of hostile cities, speedily crossed Ganga on his car and proceeded against the city of the Vitahavyas.

sa: यश्चेदं शृणुयाद् भक्त्या सावित्र्याख्यानमुत्तमम्। स सुखी सर्वसिद्धार्थो न दुःखं प्राप्नुयानरः॥
en: The man who listens with a devout spirit, to the excellent history of Savitri ever meets with happiness and success and never experiences sorrow.

sa: तथोक्ता साऽसृजद् धेनुः पुरुषान् घोरदर्शनान्॥ ते तु तद्बलमासाद्य बभञ्जुः सर्वतोदिशम्।
en: Thus addressed the cow created a number of men of terrific visages. These fought with the army of Vishvamitra and made a great onslaught.

sa: तच्छुत्वा विद्रुतं सैन्यं विश्वामित्रस्तु गाधिजः॥ तपः परं मन्यमानस्तपस्येव मनो दधे।
en: Seeing this, the troops fled away. Regarding ascetic austerities highly efficacious, Vishvamitra, the son of Gadhi made up his mind to practise the same.

sa: विज्ञाय मानुषं लोकमायान्तं मां नराधिप। प्रोवाच प्रणतो भूत्वा वदेथास्त्वं युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: O king of men, knowing that I was coming to the world of men, he bowed to me and said, "Tell this to Yudhishthira,

sa: यत् पुनर्रविणं किंचित् तत्राजीयन्त पाण्डवाः। तेभ्य एवाभ्यनुज्ञातं तत् तदा मधुसूदन॥
en: Indeed, 0 slayer of Madhu, I ordered at the time for the return of the wealth which the Pandavas had lost in that case.

sa: पञ्चमे त्वथ सम्प्राप्ते प्रथमे दिवसे गते। वराहसंस्थितं भूतं मत्समीपं समागमत्॥
en: And when the first day of the fifth month had passed away, there appeared before me a being having the appearance of a boar,

sa: सुखमसम्युषितः पुत्र त्वया सुपरिपालितः॥ महादानानि दत्तानि श्राद्धानि च पुनः पुनः।
en: Cherished by you, O son, I have lived these years very happily. I have (with your help) made large gifts and performed Sharaddhas repeatedly.

sa: कर्मणा येन केनैव मृदुना दारुणेन च। उद्धरेद् दीनमात्मानं समर्थो धर्ममाचरेत्॥
en: When you are fallen, you should raise yourself by any means, either gentle or violent. When you have raised yourself, you should practice virtue.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा सोऽसुरः पार्थं प्रागुदीची दिशं गतः। अथोत्तरेण कैलासान्मनाकं पर्वतं प्रति॥
en: Having said this to Partha, that Asura (Maya) went away in a north-eastern direction. On the north of the Kailasa near the Mainaka mountains.

sa: उक्तवांश्चापि यत् पार्थे भीष्मं प्रति नरर्षभम्॥ तथान्तो विहितस्तेन स्वयमेव महात्मना।
en: You have accused Partha that foremost of men with the slaughter of Bhisma. But this latter illustrious personage has hiinself caused his own destruction.

sa: इक्ष्वाकुकुलजः श्रीमान् मित्रं चैव भविष्यति। भविष्यसि यदाक्षज्ञः श्रेयसा योक्ष्यसे तदा।॥
en: That prosperous one, descended from the line of Ikshvaku, will be your friend. Then shall you obtain skillfulness at dice and meet your prosperity.

sa: अनागा येन निकृतस्त्वमन) जनाधिप। क्रोधादसूययित्वा तं रक्षा मे भवतः कृता॥
en: O king of men! from the person by whom, out of anger or hate, have you been cast into distress, I ilave saved you.

sa: स दृष्ट्वा विस्मितस्तस्थावात्मानं विकृतं नलः। स्वरूपधारिणं नागं ददर्श स महीपतिः॥
en: Beholding the change of form, Nala became struck with astonishment. The ruler of the earth also behold the snake to assume his real form,

sa: नागानश्वान् पदातींश्च रथिनो गजसादिनः। रौद्रा हस्तवता मुक्ताः प्रमथ्नन्ति स्म सायकाः॥
en: Fierce arrows, discharged by that one endued with great lightness of hands, crushed elephants and steeds and foot-soldiers, carwarriors and warriors riding on elephants.

sa: हयान् ध्वजं धनुर्मुष्टिमुभौ च पार्ष्णसारथी। अवाकिरत् ततो द्रोणः शरवर्षेः सहस्रशः॥
en: Then pouring arrows by thousands, Drona covered the steeds, the standards, the handle of the bow and the two Parshni drivers of his enemy.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय त्यक्त्वा तच महद् धनुः। विशीर्ण भरतश्रेष्ठ हार्दिक्याः परवीरहा॥
en: Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, taking up a fresh bow and leaving the one cut-off, that slayer of hostile heroes, namely Hridika's son.

sa: विधुन्वानौ धनुःश्रेष्ठे संदधानौ च सायकान्। विसृजन्तौ च शतशो गभस्तीनिव भास्वरौ॥
en: They stretched their two excellent bows and placed many arrows on their bow-strings. Like two suns shooting numerous rays, they also shot myriad arrows.

sa: मुहूर्तमुष्यतां तावद् यावदेवं विचिन्तये। बाढमित्येव कृत्वा च तूष्णीं गन्धर्व आस्थितः॥
en: At first, however, I told him,-Wait for a short time, till I reflect on your questions!—the Gandharva agreed to it, and sat in silence.

sa: ततो जगाम त्वरितः सहदेवो महायशाः। आकारितुं तु तान् सर्वान् भोजनार्थं नृपोत्तम॥ स्नातुं गतान् देवनद्यां दुर्वासः प्रभृतीन् मुनीन्। ते चावतीर्णाः सलिले कृतवन्तोऽघमर्षणम्॥ दृष्ट्वोद्गारान् सान्नरसांस्तृप्त्या परमया युताः। उत्तीर्य सलिलात् तस्माद् दृष्टवन्तः परस्परम्॥ दुर्वाससमभिप्रेक्ष्य ते सर्वे मुनयोऽब्रुवन्। राज्ञा हि करायित्वान्नं वयं स्नातुं समागताः॥ आकण्ठतृप्ता विप्रर्षे किंस्विद् भुञ्जामहे वयम्। वृथा पाकः कृतोऽस्माभिस्तत्र किं करवामहे॥
en: O foremost of kings, thereupon the mighty illustrious Sahaveda soon went to invite them to repast. The ascetic Durvasa and others, who had gone to the nearest river to cool and transparent water to bath, all having plunged into the river, were rubbing their persons. And they were all feeling their stomachs to be full. Coming out of the water they began to eye each other. Then turning their faces towards Durvasa they all said, "Having asked the king to get our meals ready we have come here to bathe. Our stomachs have been filled to the throat; how can we eat anything now, O Brahmana Rishi? The food has been uselessly prepared for us, what shall we do now?"

sa: यो होको हि महावीर्यो निर्दहेद् घोरचक्षुषा। कृत्त्रं दुर्योधनबलं धृतिमान् सत्यसंगरः॥
en: That mighty-armed, intelligent and brave hero of invincible might, who, singled-handed, can consume the whole host of Duryodhana by means of his terrible glances.

sa: वरचापधरा वीरा विचित्रकवचध्वजाः। विविशुस्ते परं सैन्यं सिंहा इव वनाद् वनम्॥
en: on Those heroes, welding excellent bows, owing finest armours and best standards, entered the hostile array like lions going from one forest to another.

sa: तथा तस्मिन् वर्तमाने दुष्कर्णो भ्रातुरन्तिके। चिच्छेद समरे चापं नाकुलेः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः॥
en: At this crisis, Dushkarna, who was near his brother, overwhelmed with wrath cut off the bow and arrows of the son of Nakula (Shatanika).

sa: कृताकृतपरिज्ञाने तथाऽऽयव्ययचिन्तने। संजयं योजयामास वृद्धं सर्वगुणैर्युतम्॥ बलस्य परिमाणे च भक्तवेतनयोस्तथा। नकुलं व्यादिशद् राजा कर्मणां चान्ववेक्षणे॥
en: And he appointed the old Sanjaya endued with every accomplishment, the superintendent of finances. He appointed Nakula superintendent of the forces, for giving them food and pay and for looking after other affairs of the army.

sa: पौरजानपदानां च यानि कार्याणि सर्वशः। राजानं समनुज्ञाप्य तानि कर्माणि भागशः॥
en: Everything for the citizens and the residents of the provinces should be done by you in your respective departments, after the king's permission. ever

sa: एवमादीनि कर्माणि येषां संख्या न विद्यते। अस्माकं भयभीतानां त्वं गतिर्मधुसूदन॥
en: Your acts are like those which, O slayer of Madhu, cannot be counted. You are the refuge of all who are afflicted with fear.

sa: ततो योधान् जघानाशु तेषां स दश चाष्ट च। महेन्द्रवज्रप्रतिमैरायसैर्बहुभिः शरैः॥
en: He then quickly despatched eighteen of their foremost warriors with many arrows of hard iron which resembled the arrows of the great Indra himself.

sa: सर्वे संख्ये कुरवो निष्पतन्तु मां वा लोकाः कीर्तयन्त्वाकुमारम्। सर्वानेकस्तानहं पातयिष्ये ते वा सर्वे भीमसेनं तुदन्तु॥
en: Today, either let the Kauravas fall in battle, or, let all the world sound my death knell. Alone, encountering them all, I will either overmatch them, or, let them, all combined, put an extinguisher upon Bhimasena.

sa: संजय उवाच दुःशासनबलं हत्वा सब्यसाची महारथः। सिन्धुराज परीप्सन् वै द्रोणानीकमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Having slaughtered the division of Dushasana, the mighty-armed Savysachin desirous of getting at the king of the Sindhus, fell upon Drona's division.

sa: शृणु कुन्ति कथामेतां शारदण्डायिनी प्रति। सा वीरपत्नी गुरुणा नियुक्ता पुत्रजन्मनि॥
en: O Kunti, hear the history of that wife of a hero, the daughter of Sharadandayana, who raised offspring at the command of her lord.

sa: सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय भीष्मं विव्याध पञ्चभिः। सारथिं च त्रिभिर्बाणैः सुशितै रणमूर्धनि॥
en: The latter then taking up another bow pierced Bhishma with five arrows and his charioteer with three whetted shafts on the field of battle.

sa: तां नदी क्षत्रियाः शूरा रथनागहयप्लवैः। प्रतेरुर्बहवो राजन् भयं त्यक्त्वा महारथाः॥
en: Many heroic Kshatriyas all mighty carwarriors crossed that river on their rafts consisting of cars, steeds and elephants, totally driving away fear their hearts.

sa: एवं बहुविधा वाचः श्रूयन्ते स्म परस्परम्। पाण्डवस्तवसंयुक्ताः पुत्राणां ते सुदारुणाः॥
en: Various exclamations of this kind, purporting to be applause to the Pandavas and censures to your sons, were heard there addressed to one another.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कथं कुरूणामृषभः स तु राजा युधिष्ठिरः। विप्रार्थमाराधितवान् सूर्यमद्भुतदर्शनम्॥
en: Janamejaya said : How does, for the sake of the Brahmanas, that foremost of the Kurus, king Yudhishthira, worshipped the sun of wonderful appearance?

sa: अभ्युद्ययू रणे पार्थान् भीष्मं कृत्वाऽग्रतो नृप। तथैव पाण्डवा राजन् भीमसेनपुरोगमा:॥
en: So also, O king, the Pandavas headed by Bhimasena himself, and desirous of wining victory, rushed to battle with a view to cncounter Bhishma.

sa: धर्माश्रितेयं त कथा कथितेयं तवानघ। यां श्रुत्वा मुनयः प्रीता नैमिषारण्यवासिनः॥
en: O sinless one, the theme relating to virtue and morality is now over. Having heard them, the Rishis, in the Naimisha forest, greatly delighted.

sa: शिरसा त्वाभियाचेऽहं कुरुष्व करुणां मयि। बान्धवेषु च सर्वेषु भूतेष्विव महेश्वरः॥
en: I beseech you with bent head. Be you merciful to me, to all our friends, and, O great lord, to all creatures in general.

sa: वानराणां विनाशोऽयं राक्षसानां च ते रणे। तव चैव महाबाहो दैवयोगादुपागतः॥
en: O you of huge arms-the destruction of the monkeys and the Rākşasas as well as that of yourself has been brought about by Accident.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनः प्रत्यविध्यदापतन्तं शितैः शरैः। कर्णं वैकर्तनं श्रीमान् विकृष्य बलवद् धनुः॥
en: Then the illustrious Arjuna, seeing the son of Vikartana, Karna, coming towards him, drew his tough bow and pierced him with his sharp arrows.

sa: कृत्वा तु तन्महाप्राज्ञः सभविष्यां सहोत्तरम्। चिन्तयामास को न्वेतत् प्रयुञ्जीयादिति प्रभुः॥
en: And having composed it, including as well future incidents to happen afterwards, that lord relected as to who should publish the same before assemblies.

sa: धन्यस्त्वं न त्वया तुल्यं पश्यामि जगतीतले। अयत्नादागतं राज्यं यस्त्वं त्यक्तुमिहेच्छसि॥
