en: Blessed are you! Your like find I none on earth, inasmuch as you wish to resign a kingdom that comes to you without search.

sa: जहि मातुलं संग्रामे भीमसेनं महाबलम्। अस्मिञ्जिते जितं मन्ये पाण्डवेयं महाबलम्॥
en: Overpower in the battle, O uncle, the allpowerful Bhimasena. The victory over the vast array of the Pandava forces hinges on his final overthrow.

sa: लाघवेन तु संयुक्तो विद्युन्माली निशाचरः। अपक्रम्य रथातूर्णं गदापाणिः क्षितौ स्थितः॥
en: Thereat, endowed with lightness, that nightranger, Vidyunmāli, at once extricating himself from his car, stood on the ground with a mace in his hand.

sa: सा दष्टा तेन सर्पण पपात सहसा भुवि। विवर्णा विगतश्रीका भ्रष्टाभरणचेतना॥
en: Bitten by the snake, she suddenly fell senseless on the ground with her colour faded all her beauties gone and all her ornaments scattered.

sa: अभिजानामि पुष्पाणि तानीमानीह लक्ष्मण ॥ अपिनद्धानि वैदेह्या मया दत्तानि कानने।
en: O Lakşmaņa, I have come to know that these are the flowers of the forest I gave Vaidehī; with these she decorated her hair.

sa: जघानाश्वांस्तरसा तस्य संख्ये। हत्वा चाश्वान् सात्यकेः सूतपुत्रः कैकेयपुत्रं न्यवधीद् विसोकम्॥
en: Then he, striking Dhristadyumna with six arrows, almost instantly knocked down his and Satyaki's horses and then in quick succession killed Vishoka-the Kaikeya prince.

sa: भगवन् स्वागतं तेऽस्तु किं करोमि तवानघ। भवानाज्ञापयतु मामाज्ञाप्यो भवता ह्यहम्॥
en: Hail, O worshipful sir! What shall I do to you, O sinless one? Do you command. Surely, I deserve to be commanded by you.

sa: दहन् मृतानि भूतानी तस्याग्निर्भरतोऽभवत्। अग्निष्टोमे च नियतः क्रतुश्रेष्ठो भरस्य तु॥
en: His son, the Bharata fire, consumes the dead bodies of all creatures. His first Kratu is known as Niyata at the performance of Agnishtoma.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच तां तूपयातो राजेन्द्र शाल्व: सौभपतिस्तदा। प्रभूतनरनागेन बलेनोपविवेश ह॥
en: Krishna said : O king of kings, the lord of Saubha Shalva, came to the city of Dvarka with numerous men, elephants and soldiers.

sa: आश्वसध्वं न भी: कार्या सौभराडद्य नश्यति। मयाभिपन्नो दुष्टात्मा ससौभो विनशिष्यति॥
en: Be of good cheer, Fear not. I shall today kill him. Attacked by me, the wicked-minded (Shalva) with (his car) SAubha will be destroyed."

sa: प्रभवार्थं हि भूतानां धर्मः सृष्टः स्वयम्भुवा। तस्मात् प्रवर्तयेद् धर्म प्रजानुग्रहकारणात्॥
en: The Self-create created Dharma for the aggrandisement and growth of creatures. Therefore, a king should follow the dictates of Dharma for benefiting his people.

sa: धर्मस्य ब्राह्मणो योनिस्तस्मात् पूजयेत् सदा। ब्राह्मणानां च मान्धातः कुर्यात् कामानमत्सरी॥
en: Dharma, again, has originated from the Brahmana. Therefore, the Brahmana should always be adored. You, should, O Mandhatri, satisfy humbly the wishes of Brahmanas.

sa: रावणस्तु सहामात्यो मन्त्रयित्वा विमृश्य च। लङ्कायास्तु तदा गुप्तिं कारयामास राक्षसः॥
en: The Räkşasa, Rāvaņa, along with his courtiers, having consulted together as to what was fit to be done, set about the defence of Lankā.

sa: हताश्वात् तु रथात् कर्णः समाप्लुत्य विशाम्पते। स्यन्दनं वृषसेनस्य तूर्णमापुप्लुवे भयात्॥
en: Jumping down from the car of which the steeds were slain, O ruler of men, the mighty car-warrior Karna ascended the chariot of Vrisasena.

sa: जरितोवाच अयमग्निर्दहन् कक्षमित आयाति भीषणः। जगत् संदीपयन् भीमो मम दुःखविवर्धनः॥
en: Jarita said : Alas, the terrible fire, the enhancer of my misery, is coming towards us, illuminating the whole universe and burning the forest.

sa: जीवेयं खलु सौमित्रे मया सह सुमध्यमा। सेवेत यदि वैदेही पम्पायाः पवनं शुभम्॥ पद्मसौगन्धिकवहं शिवं शोकविनाशनम्। धन्या लक्ष्मण सेवन्ते पम्पाया वनमारुतम्॥
en: It is then that I shall draw my vital breath, O Saumitri, if Vaidehi, of slender waist, with me, enjoy the fine breeze of Pampā dispersing the fragrance of lotuses and Saugandhikas and ever assuaging grief. Blessed are they, O Laksmana who enjoy this wild breeze of Pampā.

sa: एष पुष्पवहो वायुः सुखस्पर्शो हिमावहः। तां विचिन्तयतः कान्तां पावकप्रतिमो मम॥
en: This cool breeze of a pleasant touch, carrying the fragrance of flowers appears like a fire-brand to me who am thinking of my spouse.

sa: संस्कारक्रमसम्पन्नामद्भुतामविलम्बिताम्। उच्चारयति कल्याणी वाचं हृदयहर्षिणीम्॥
en: He has uttered accents, which was wonderful, ready, accomplished, auspicious and captivating.

sa: अभिसृत्य च राजानं विदिता च प्रवेशिता। सह तेनैव पुत्रेण बालार्कसमतेजसा॥
en: Having sent words, she entered the royal court with her son, as effulgent as the morning sun. And she was then introduced to him.

sa: सैवमुक्ता वरारोहा वीडितेव तपस्विनी। नि:संज्ञेव च दुःखेन तस्थौ स्थूणेव निश्चला॥
en: Thus being addressed, the beautiful ascetic lady was filled with shame. She lost her consciousness from grief and she stood like a wooden post.

sa: अत्र ते हृदयं वेद सत्यस्यैवानृतस्य च। कल्याणं वद साक्ष्येण माऽऽत्मानमवमन्यथाः॥
en: Your heart is the witness to the truth or to the falsehood of my words. Therefore, speak the truth and do not degrade yourself.

sa: तौ तस्य पादौ प्रदिशो दिशश्च गिरेगुहाश्चैव महार्णवं च। लङ्कां च सेनां कपिराक्षसानां विनादयन्तौ विनिपेततुश्च ॥
en: Thereupon those legs (of his), making all sides and quarters and rocks and caves and the mighty main and Lankā herself and the army of the monkeys and the Rākşasas, resound, dropped down (on the ground).

sa: कृतं भारसहस्रस्य शूलं कालायसं महत्। बभञ्ज जानुमारोप्य तदा हृष्टः प्लवंगमः॥
en: And placing the same on his thighs, (Hanuman) snapped that ponderous and terrible dart composed of black iron, and thereat the monkeys waxed delighted.

sa: वाक्प्रतोदेन तौ वीरौ प्रणुनौ तनयेन ते। प्रावर्तयेतां संग्रामं घट्टिताविव पन्नगौ॥
en: Thus pierced with the goad of speech by your son, those two heroes once more engaged in battle like two snakes poked with sticks.

sa: मदर्थेऽधिष्ठिता नूनं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य शासनात्। एतान् प्रमथ्य संग्रामे प्रियार्थे तव कौरव॥
en: Are made to wait for me at Duryodhana's command. For your good, O foremost descendant of the Kuru race, crushing these warriors in battle.

sa: मन्त्रिणो बाढमित्याहुः सह सर्वैर्महर्षिभिः। सुप्रीतश्चाब्रवीद् राजा श्वो यात्रेति च मन्त्रिणः॥
en: Thereupon, the counsellors along with the Maharsis said, Excellent! And the king highly delighted, said to the counsellors, Our journey commence on the morrow.

sa: सत्यात् पाणिगृहीतश्च कृतकर्मा महायशाः। विस्मृतो राघवो येन स कस्य सुकृतं स्मरेत्॥ लक्ष्मणस्य भयेनेह नाधर्मभयभीरुणा। आदिष्टा मार्गितुं सीता धर्मस्तस्मिन् कथं भवेत्॥
en: Whose good office remembereth he who could forget the renowned Räghava himself of mighty deeds, after having, in the name of truth, taken his hand? How can he reap religious merit that directed us to search Sītā here, from fear of Laksmana, and not from fear of unrighteousness?

sa: सम्पृष्टेन तु वक्तव्यं सचिवेन विपश्चिता। उद्यताञ्जलिना राज्ञा य इच्छेद् भूतिमात्मनः॥
en: A wise counsellor who wishes prosperity to himself should always communicate to his master his desire with joined hands whenever asked to do so.

sa: प्रत्याख्यातोऽस्मि गुरुणा गुरुपुत्रैस्तथैव च॥ अनवाप्यैव तं कामं मया प्राप्तो विपर्ययः।
en: Disregarded had I been by my spiritual guide as well as his sons. And far from attaining my desire, I came by this calamity.

sa: ब्रूयाश्चैनं त्वमासीनं कुरुभिः परिवारितम्। तवैव राजन् वीर्येण सुखं जीवन्ति पाण्डवाः॥
en: And you shall say to him, who will be seated surrounded by the Kurus-The sons of Pandu are living happily solely through your prowess.

sa: अथोचितं स्वकं भागं लभेमहि परंतप। निवर्तय परद्रव्याद् बुद्धिं गृद्धां नरर्षभ॥
en: But o repressor of enemies, we want our due share; O best among men, turn away your avaricious inclination from what belongs to others.

sa: तेन संचिन्तितो देवो मनसा विष्णुरव्ययः। सर्वत्रगः प्रभुः श्रीमानागतश्च स्थितौ बभौ॥
en: He mentally thought of the eternal deity Vishnu; and the graceful lord of the universe who is present everywhere appeared and stood before him.

sa: तेषु धर्मानुपूर्वी तां प्रयुज्य मधुसूदनः। यथावयः समीयाय राजभिः सह माधवः॥
en: Madhava, the slayer of Madhu, having done honour to them according to the usual custom, exchanged words with other kings according to their age.

sa: एतद्धि त्रितयं श्रेष्ठं सर्वभूतेषु भारत। निर्वैरता महाराज सत्यमक्रोध एव च॥
en: These three, O king, are the foremost of all concerns, O Bharata, viz., abstension from injury to any creation, truth, and freedom from anger.

sa: अश्वत्थामा तु त. दृष्ट्वा यत्नवन्तौ महारथौ। प्रहृष्टः शनकै राजन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing them ready to work Ashvatthaman was overjoyed, and addressing them whisperingly, O king, said,-'If you two exert, you can exterminate all the Kshariyas.

sa: तामुवाच मुनिः क्रुद्धो वसिष्ठं शीघ्रमानय। यावदेनं निहन्म्यद्य तच्छ्रुत्वा व्यथिता नदी॥
en: Filled with ire, the ascetic said her-Bring here Vashishtha without delay, so that I my kill him.' Hearing these words, the river became agitated.

sa: ततः परमसंक्रुद्धः पुनरेव महातपाः। ह्यस्तनेन च कोपेन शक्ति वै प्राहिणोन्मयि॥
en: Thereupon he, of great asceticism, was greatly incensed and remembering what had happened the day before, he hurled, with anger, a dart at me,

sa: श्यालस्तु तव संक्रुद्धो माद्रीपुत्रं हसन्निव। कर्णिनैकेन विव्याध हृदये निशितेन ह॥
en: Inflamed with wrath, your brother-in-law, pierced, as it were with a smile, the son of Madri in the chest with keen and barbed dart.

sa: न भूतपूर्वं बीभत्सोर्वाक्यं परुषमीदृशम्। अथ कस्मात् स कौन्तेयः सखायं रूक्षमुक्तवान्॥
en: Ere this Vibhatsu had never addressed such words to him; why then did the son of Kunti address his friend in that harsh language.

sa: ब्राह्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा संतप्तोऽथ युधिष्ठिरः। धनुरादाय कौन्तेयः प्राद्रवद् भ्रातृभिः सह॥
en: Hearing the words of the Brahmana, Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, became very sorry and taking his bow sallied out together with his brothers.

sa: बद्ध्वा च भ्रुकुटि वक्त्रे क्रोधस्य प्रतिलक्षणम्। देवदत्तं महाशङ्ख पूरयामास पाण्डवः॥
en: Causing a frown indicative of wrath to gather on his brow, the son of Pandu charged his mighty conch called Devadatta with his breath.

sa: तं तु क्रुद्धमभिप्रेक्ष्य ब्रह्मवध्याभयानदी। अपोवाह वसिष्ठं तु प्राची दिशमतन्द्रिता॥ उभयोः कुर्वती वाक्यं वञ्चयित्वा च गाधिजम्।
en: Seeing him wrathful, the river, fearing to behold a Brahmana's slaughter, quickly bore Vashishtha away to her eastern bank once more. She thus had obeyed the words of both, although she deceived Vishvamitra by her act.

sa: अद्य तद्विपरीतं ते वदतोऽस्मासु दृश्यते। यदि त्वं शत्रुमात्मानं मन्यसे तत्तथास्त्विह॥
en: Thinking thus we used to humble ourselves to you. But as you speak such words today, it seems that all that has been changed.

sa: कृष्णो यस्य प्रसीदेत लोकास्तेनाक्षया जिताः॥ यश्चैवैनं भयस्थाने केशवं शरणं व्रजेत्।
en: Regions of undeteriorating blessedness is secured by him on whom Krishna becomes gracious. He that seeks protection from Keshava in seasons of danger, and

sa: यत्प्रयुक्तो जन्तुरयं वैतृष्ण्यं नाधिगच्छति। तृष्णात इह निम्नानि धावमानो न बुध्यते॥
en: Urged by that fault, this individual soul fails to attain to freedom from desire. Possessed by desire, one runs into ditches without knowing it.

sa: सव्यसाची तु संक्रुद्धो विकृष्य बलवद् धनुः। हयांश्चकार निर्जीवान् सारथेश्च शिरोऽहरत्॥
en: Then Dhananjaya, becoming angry, drew his bow with great force, and killed his antagonist's horses and then struck off the head of his car-driver.

sa: एवं वसन् सर्वतो वर्धतीह बहून् पुत्राँल्लभते च प्रतिष्ठाम्। वर्षन्ति चास्मै प्रदिशो दिशश्च वसन्त्यस्मिन् ब्रह्मचर्ये जनाश्च॥
en: With this rule of life one prospers in every way and obtains many sons and fame; to such a man, wealth is poured from all sides and to that place many people come for practicing asceticism.

sa: व्यसनान्नित्यभीतो यः समृद्ध्या यो न दुष्यति। यत् स्यादेवंविधं मित्रं तदात्मसममुच्यते॥
en: That friend is like your own self who is filled with fear when calamity befalls you and with joy when prosperity smiles on you.

sa: राजानो हि स्वधर्मेण श्रियमिच्छन्ति भूयसीम्। सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां त्राता राजा भवत्युत॥
en: Indeed, the kings, practising their own special virtues, crave for immense prosperity. In fact, the king is the preserver of all the four classes.

sa: आकिंचन्यं मुनीनां च इति वै नहुघोऽब्रवीत्। कृत्वा नृशंसं ह्यधने धिगस्त्वधनतामिह॥
en: Having perpetrated many wicked acts in a state of poverty, king Nahusha spoke ill of that state and said that poverty is for recluses.

sa: परस्परं समागम्य योधास्ते भरतर्षभ। मुनेः प्रसादात् ते ह्येवं क्षत्रिया नष्टमन्यवः॥
en: All those warriors, O chief of Bharata's race, meeting with one another through the favour of the great ascetic, became reconciled with one another.

sa: शल्यं नवत्या विव्याध त्रिसप्तया च सूतजम्। तांस्तस्य गोप्तन् विव्याध त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः॥
en: He pierced Shalya with ninty and struk Karna with seventy-three arrows. He also struck every one of Karna's body guards with three straight arrows.

sa: तृणानि भूमिरुदकं वाक् चतुर्थी च सूनृता। सतामेतानि गेहेषु नोच्छिद्यन्ते कदाचन॥ देयमार्तस्य शयनं स्थितश्रान्तस्य चासनम्। तृषितस्य च पानीयं क्षुधितस्य च भोजनम्॥
en: "The houses of good men can never be in want of grass, space, water and sweet words, the fourth. Bed to the tired, seat to one who is fatigued by standing, water to on who is thirsty and food to one who is hungry should be always given.

sa: यस्य वाङ्मनसीगुप्ते सम्यक् प्रणिहिते सदा। वेदास्तपश्च त्यागश्च स इदं सर्वमाप्नुयात्॥
en: That person whose speech and mind are properly controlled and always devoted to the Supreme, gets the fruits of the Vedas, Penances, and Renunciation.

sa: पापान्यबुद्धवेह पुरा कृतानि प्राग् धर्मशीलोऽपि विहन्ति पश्चात्। धर्मो राजन् नुदते पूरुषाणां यत् कुर्वते पापमिह प्रमादात्॥
en: A person, who was formerly virtuous, having committed sins out of ignorance, can destroy those sins afterwards. O monarch, the virtue of persons shines again (drives off all sins), if sins are committed out of mistake.

sa: यं गङ्गा गर्भविधिना धारयामास पार्थिव। वसिष्ठशिक्षितं तात तमस्मि मनसा गतः॥
en: I was thinking of him whom Ganga conceived and gave birth to, according to ordinary human laws and whom Vasishtha took as a pupil.

sa: कुन्त्युवाच कौन्तेयस्त्वं न राधेयो न तवाधिरथः पिता। नासि सूतकुले जातः कर्ण तद् विद्धि मे वचः॥
en: Kunti said You are the son of Kunti and not the son of Radha; nor is Adhiratha your father; you are not born in the race of Suta; know this word of mine to be true.

sa: ततस्ते तु कुरुक्षेत्रं प्राप्ता नरवरोत्तमाः॥ प्रतीच्यभिमुखं देशं यथोद्दिष्टं सुतेन ते।
en: Proceeding with face westwards to the appointed spot, with your son (in their midst), they spread themselves on all sides when they reached it.

sa: साङ्गदः सतलत्राणः सरथो रथिनां वरः। तस्य कार्णायसं वर्म हेमचित्रं महर्द्धिमत्॥
en: Adorned with Angadas and his hands protected with leathern gloves mounted on his car. His precious armour made of steel and adorned with gold.

sa: ऋषयस्त्वां क्षमामाहुः सत्यं च पुरुषोत्तम। सत्याद् यज्ञोऽसि सम्भूतः कश्यपस्त्वां यथाब्रवीत्।
en: O best of Purushas (male beings), the Rishis call you Forgiveness and Truth. Kashyapa has said that you are the sacrifice sprung from Truth.

sa: न ददर्श ततो हंसान् जातरूपपरिष्कृतान्। वने विचरतां तेषामेकं जचाह पक्षिणम्॥
en: There he saw, one day, a lot of swans, with golden wings, roving in those woods. Of them he caught one with his hands.

sa: सद्भिस्तु सह संसर्गः शोभते धर्मदर्शिभिः। नित्यं सर्वास्ववस्थासु नासद्भिरिति मे मतिः॥
en: In my opinion, it is proper for them to mix under all circumstances, with good men devoted to virtue, but never with the wicked.

sa: च चापि शरवर्षं तं शरवर्षेण वासविः। अप्राप्तमेव चिच्छेद भगदत्तस्य वीर्यवान्॥
en: Then the son of Vasava (Arjuna) endued with prowess, cut-off with his arrowy showers, the arrows of Bhagadatta, before they could even reach him.

sa: यस्य नित्यमृता वाचः स्वैरेष्वपि महात्मनः। त्रैलोक्यमपि तस्य स्याद् योद्धा यस्यधनंजयः॥
en: That high-souled one (Yudhishthira) whose words are ever true and who has Dhananjaya (Arjuna) to fight for him will certainly conquer the three worlds.

sa: इरावानपि खड्ड्रेन दर्शयन् पाणिलाघवम्। अभ्यवर्तत तान् सर्वान् सौबलान् बलदर्पितः।। :॥
en: Iravat also proud of his strength, and displaying the lightness of his hands by whirling his sword, rushed against all those sons of Subala.

sa: तेषामर्थे महाराज योद्धव्यमिति मे मतिः। अतस्त्वां क्लीबवद् ब्रूयां युद्धादन्यत् किमिच्छसि॥
en: O king, I must fight for them. I therefore speck like a eunuch in telling you, “Battle excepted, what do you desire to get?"

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच यथा वदसि मे सूत एकस्य बहुभिः सह। संग्रामं तुमुलं घोरं जयं चैव महात्मनः॥ अश्रद्धेयमिवाश्चर्यं सौभद्रस्याथ विक्रमम्। किं तु नात्यद्भुतं तेषां येषां धर्मो व्यपाश्रयः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said What you are saying to me, O Suta, about the fierce and awful battle between one and the many and the victory of that high-souled one, this story of the prowess of Subhadra's son is wonderful and none the less incredible. But I do not regard it altogether impossible with respect of them whose sole refuge is virtue.

sa: अनुमानये त्वां दुर्धर्ष योत्स्ये विगतकल्मषः। जयेयं नु परान् राजन्ननुज्ञातस्त्वया रिपून्॥
en: Yudhishthira said O invincible hero, if I fight with your perinission, I will not incur sin. With your permission I shall defeat my enemies.

sa: नतैनमिति चुक्रोश क्षत्रियान् क्षत्रियर्षभः। ततो द्रोण: कृपः कर्णो द्रोणपुत्रो बृहद्बलः॥
en: And then that foremost of the Kshatriyas commanded his other Kshatriya warriors saying 'Slay him.' Thereupon Drona, his son, Kripa, Karna and Brihadbala and.

sa: अशोभिता दिशः सर्वाः पांसुवर्षेः समन्ततः। उत्पातमेघा रौद्राश्च रात्रौ वर्षन्ति शोणितम्॥
en: All direction of the earth, covered by showers of dust appears greatly inauspicious. Fearful clouds, foreboding evil, pour showers of blood in the night.

sa: तस्य पार्थो धनुश्छित्त्वा हस्तावापं च पञ्चभिः। अथैनं सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भृशं विव्याध मर्मणि।॥
en: Then Partha having cut off the former's bow and gloves with five arrows, pierced him in his vital parts with arrows of great sharpness.

sa: छित्त्वा धनूंषि शूराणां शरांश्च बहुधा रणे। पातयामासतुर्वीरौ शिरांसि शतशो नृणाम्॥
en: Cutting off the bows and arrows of the heroes in battle, those two fierce warriors began to fell the heads of men by hundreds.

sa: सुशर्माणं कृपं चैव त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरविध्यता प्राग्ज्योतिषं च समरे सैन्धवं च जयद्रथम्॥
en: He pierced Susharma and Kripa, each with three shafts; then in that battle, the ruler of the Pragjyotishas, Jayadratha, the ruler of the Sindhus,

sa: तेऽपि तं समरे राजन् विव्यधुनिशितैः शरैः॥ स तथा पीड्यमानोऽपि सर्वशस्त्रैर्महारथैः।
en: Those heroes also, O king, pierced him with exceedingly sharp arrows. Through thus pierced by all those mighty car-warriors with all kinds of weapons.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय गौतमो रथिनां वरः॥ भीमं विव्याध संरब्धो दशभिर्निशितैः शरैः।
en: Therefore that Dhananjaya of car-warriors, that son of Gautami, taking up another bow and waxing worth, pierced Bhima with ten shafts of great sharpness.

sa: अजेयः समरे चापि देवैरपि सवासवैः। बलवान् बुद्धिमांश्चैव जितक्लेशो युधां वरः॥
en: He is invincible in battle cven by the celestial headed by Vasava himself. He is mighty, quick-witted, indefeasible and the foremost of ali warriors;

sa: म्लेच्छाश्चार्याश्च ये तत्र ददृशुः शुश्रुवुस्तथा। वृत्तं तत् पाण्डुपुत्राणां रुरुदुस्ते सगद्गदाः॥
en: Both the Aryas and the Mlecchas that saw or heard of this conduct of the Pandavas all wept with their voice choked with tears.

sa: एतद् विचिन्तयानस्य प्रज्ञा सीदति मे भृशम्। अभ्युद्यतो रणे पार्थः कुरुवृद्धमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Thus as I reflect, my mind mis-gives, knowing that Arjuna is rushing against the old grandsire of the Kurus, highly wrought up with rage.

sa: कङ्का गृध्रा बलाकश्च व्याहरन्ति मुहुर्मुहुः। शिवाश्चैवाशिवा घोरा वेदयन्त्यो महद् भयम्॥
en: The Kanka birds, the vultures and the cranes are incessantly uttering cries. The jackals are uttering inauspicious and dreadful yells foreboding a terrible calamity.

sa: न निर्दहति ते यावत् क्रोधदीप्तेक्षणश्चमूम्। युधिष्ठिरो रणे तावत् संधिस्ते तात युज्यताम्॥ नकुलः सहदेवश्च भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः। यावच्चमू महाराज नाशयन्ति न सर्वशः॥
en: As long as Yudhishthira does not burn down your army with his eyes flashing the fire of wrath, let peace by concluded with him, O sire. As long as Nakula, Sahadeva, and Pandu's son Bhimasena, do not totally crush your army down, let peace be made with them.

sa: गुरुपुत्रं समासाद्य प्रहरन्तौ महाबलौ॥ अश्वत्थामा ततस्तौ तु विव्याध बहुभिः शरैः।
en: Then Ashvathama pierced with numerous shafts those two mighty warriors who having neared the son of the preceptor, had been wounding him with arrows.

sa: इति सेनापतेः श्रुत्वा पाण्डवानां महारथाः॥ अभ्यद्रवन्त संहृष्टा गाङ्गेयस्य रथं प्रति।
en: Hearing these words of their generallissimo, the mighty car-warriors.of the Pandava host, with delighted hearts, rushed against the car of the son of Ganga.

sa: ततो हतानि भूतानि चराणि स्थावराणि च। महता क्रोधवेगेन त्रासयन्निव वीर्यवान्॥
en: Then mobile and immobile, all creatures were annihilated. Verily the puissant Brahma did all this, frightening the worlds with the fierceness of his angers.

sa: कोपिताः पाण्डवा नित्यं समाश्रित्य सुयोधनम्। अवश्यभावी ह्यर्थोऽयं योन शक्यो निवर्तितुम्॥
en: For the interests of Duryodhana, I have hitherto always incited the Pandavas against me; the result is inevitable and none possibly can prevent it.

sa: सम्प्राप्यैव गता नाशं शलभा इव पारकम्॥ ततो मत्स्याः केकयाश्च धनुर्वेदविशारदाः।
en: Approaching him met with their destruction, like insects burning on fire. Thereupon the Matsyas and the Kaikeyas all accomplished in the science of bowmanship,

sa: सर्वे हि सृष्टा नश्यन्ति तव देव कथंचन। तस्मानिवर्ततां तेजस्त्वय्येवेदं प्रलीयताम्॥
en: All created things, O Divine Being' that belong to you, are being consumed; therefore withdraw your energy, let it be quenched in your ownself.

sa: पश्य सैन्यानि गाङ्गेय द्रवमाणानि सर्वशः। पाण्डवेन युधां श्रेष्ठ काल्यमानानि संयुगे॥
en: Behold, O son of Ganga, O foremost of warriors, my troops routed and afflicted in battle, on all sides by that son of Pandu.

sa: तस्मिन् हते तु भगवन् केतौ सर्वधनुष्मताम्। यदचेष्टत कौरव्यस्तन्मे ब्रूहि तपोधन॥
en: O illustrious ascetic, tell me all that the foremost of the Kuru dynasty did, when that chief of all bowmen (Bhima) had been killed.

sa: पार्थिवाः पृथिवीहेतोः समभित्यज्य जीवितम्। न वा शाम्यन्ति निघ्नन्तो वर्धयन्ति यमक्षयम्॥
en: They are not to be restrained. They striking one another and giving up their lives will increase the population of the abode of Yama.

sa: शाश्वतोऽयं स्थितो धर्मः क्षत्रियाणां धनंजय। योद्धव्यं रक्षितव्यं च यष्टव्यं चानसूयुभिः॥
en: This, O Dhananjaya, is the eternal duty prescribed for Kshatriyas viz., they should fight, protect their subjects, and perform sacrifices, all without any maliciousness.

sa: यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम्। असम्मूढः स मर्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: He, who knows Me to be unborn, free from delusion, without beginning, the supreme Lord of all the world, is released from all sins.

sa: वरासिना कर्णपक्षान् जघान दश पञ्च च। पुनस्तु रथमास्थाय धनुरदाय चापरम्॥
en: Then once more ascending his car and taking up a bow he pierced Karna with ten and his horses and charioteer with five shafts.

sa: गुरुणा कुरुवृद्धेन कृतप्रज्ञेन धीमता। पितामहेन संग्रामे कथं योद्धाऽस्मि माधव॥ ते
en: "How, O Madhava, shall I fight in battle, with the venerable and aged preceptor of the Kurus, the grandsire of accomplished understanding and intelligence.

sa: दस्यवश्च तदान्योन्यं जघ्नुर्मूर्खा विचेतसः। हत्वा परस्परं नष्टाः कुमारं चाद्भुतं भुवि॥
en: The robbers then, ignorant and idiotic as they were, slew one another; for having slain that wonderful prince, they also met with their destruction.

sa: ततोऽपश्यं दिविष्ठान् वै तानष्टौ ब्रह्मवादिनः। ते मां स्मयन्तो राजेन्द्र शनकैरिदमब्रुवन्॥
en: Then I saw those eight speakers of the Brahma, stationed in the sky. O great king, smilingly they spoke these words to me slowly.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा संध्यां संदृश्य भारत। वध्यमानं च भीष्मेण त्यक्तास्त्रं भयविह्वलम्॥ स्वसैन्यं च परावृत्तं पलायनपरायणम्। भीष्मं च युधि संरब्ध पीडयन्तं महारथम्॥ सोमकांश्च जितान् दृष्ट्वा निरुत्साहान् महारथान्। चिन्तयित्वा ततो राजा अवहारमरोचयत्॥
en: Then o Bharata, king Yudhishthira, beholding that twilight had set in and that his own soldiers, slaughtered by Bhishma, had thrown down their weapons, and that terrorstruck and repulsed from the field of battle, they are flying away in all directions; beholding also the mighty car-warrior Bhishma inflicting everybody, and seeing also the mighty car-warriors if the Somakas defeated and cheerless, pondered a while and then commanded the withdrawal of the forces.

sa: सैन्येन रजसा ध्वस्तं निर्मर्यादमवर्तत। ततः सेनापतिः शीघ्रमयं काल इति ब्रुवन्॥
en: Then the generalissimo of the Pandava troops saying “This is the opportune moment" quickly led the Pandavas ever endowed with activity, to the battle.

sa: समाभाष्यैवमपरं प्रगृह्य रुचिरं धनुः। मुमोच समरे भीष्मः शरान् पार्थरथं प्रति॥
en: Having thus applauded Partha and taking up another bow of great excellence, Bhishma sped, in that battle, arrows against the chariot of the former.

sa: परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात् सनातनः। यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति॥
en: But there is another entity, unmanifested and eternal, which is beyond the unmanifested beings, and which is not destroyed when all entities are destroyed.

sa: ततो जगाम वसुधां मम बाणप्रपीडितः। जानुभ्यां धनुरुत्सृज्य रामो मोहवशं गतः॥
en: He then fell down on his knees on the earth, overwhelmed by my arrow with his bow loosened from his grasp, and swooned away.

sa: एवं कामान् परित्यज्य ययातिकृतिमेत्य च। पूरूं राज्ये प्रतिष्ठाप्य प्रयातो वनमीश्वरः॥
en: Thus having renounced all his desires and cultivating contentment, the Lord Yayati retired into the woods, having installed his son Puru on the throne.

sa: तामापतन्ती सहसा द्विधा चिच्छेद भारत। क्षुरप्राभ्यां सुतीक्ष्णाभ्यां सा व्यशीर्यत मेदिनीम्॥
en: Flew swiftly, like the last night (of worldly existence) of a doomed man. Then 0 Bharata, Bhishma cut in twin that swift coursing lance,

sa: तथैव पाण्डवा राजन सर्वोद्योगेन दंशिताः। प्रययुः फाल्गुनार्थाय यत्र भीष्मो व्यतिष्ठत॥
en: So also, O king, the Pandavas, clad in armour, rushed, with all their energies, to the spot where Bhishma was, desirous of rescuing Partha.

sa: अस्त्रैरेव महाबाहो चिकीर्षनधिकां क्रियाम्। ततो दिवि महान् नादः प्रादुरासीत् समन्ततः॥
en: In fact, O you of long arms, I performed mightier tasks by my weapons on which there was a loud commotion all about, oking.

sa: ततोऽहं शरवर्षेण महता समवाकिरम्। स च मां शरवर्षेण वर्षन्तं समवाकिरत्॥
en: Then did I, all on a sudden, cover him with a great shower of arrows: and he too covered me with shower of arrows.

sa: पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ। जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु॥
en: I am the fragrance in the earth, the refulgence in the fire, I am the life in all beings, and the penance in ascetics.

sa: संजय उवाच कर्णस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा। सेनामध्यगतं द्रोणमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereupon having listened to the words of Karna, king Duryodhana thus addressed Drona who was standing in the midst of the soldiers.

sa: उपास्यते तिग्मतेजा यत्र भूतैः समन्ततः। नरनारायणौ ब्रह्मा मनुः स्थाणुश्च पञ्चमः॥
en: Endued with supreme energy, surrounded by his ghostly attendants, is adored. There Nara and Narayana and Brahma and Manu and Sthanu are ever present.

sa: ब्रह्मद्विषां चाथ तस्मिन् सहस्राणि चतुर्दश। पुनरन्यानि जग्राह दन्तक्रूरं जघान ह॥
en: In that slaughter were included fourteen thousand Kshatriyas all contemners of the Brahmanas. Then again he slew slew many Kshatriyas of the Dantakrura country.

sa: आह्वयानः स मां युद्धे मनो हर्षयतीव मे। पुनः पुनरभिक्रोशन्नभियाहीति भार्गवः॥
en: When he challenged me to fight my heart was very much pleased. The descendant of Bhrigu said to me again and again "come, come.”

sa: भीष्मेण तु रणे पार्थाः पालिता बाहुशालिना॥ तांस्तु कर्णः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्नाशयिष्यति संयुगे।
en: The sons of Pritha were tenderly treated by the mighty-armed Bhishma in battle. But Karna shall slay them in the encounter with sharpened arrows.

sa: न चैनं तावका राजन् विषेहुररिघातिनम्। प्रदीप्तं पावकं यद्वत् पतङ्गाः कालचोदिताः॥
en: Your troops, O king, could not bear that slayer of foes, like insects failing to bear a blazing fire, when urged on by Fate.

sa: न मूलफलभक्षस्य विष्ठा भवति लोमशा॥ अस्य गात्राणि वर्धन्ते गणश्च परिहीयते।
en: The evacuation of animals eating roots and fruits, cannot have hairs in it; his body is growing fatter while we are decreasing in numbers.

sa: इमे ते भ्रातरः सर्वे दीना भरतसत्तम। त्वयि शोकसमाविष्टे नृपाश्च सुहृदस्तव॥
en: O foremost of the Bharatas, these your brothers are highly distressed. As also these monarchs and these your relatives, beholding you plunged in sorrow.

sa: यथा हि पशुमध्यस्थो दारयेत पशून् वृकः। वृकोदरस्तव सुतांस्तथा व्यद्रावयद् रणे॥
en: Just a wolf, remaining inside a herd of cattle, chases and terrifies them, so, in that battle, did Vrikodara crush and frighten your sons.

sa: संजय उवाच धार्तराष्ट्रबलं दृष्ट्वा युद्धाय समुपस्थितम्। अर्जुनस्य हितार्थाय कृष्णो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Having seen the army of Dhritarashtra's son approach with the desire to fight, Krishna spoke these words to Arjuna for his benefit.

sa: ततो बलेन महता पुत्रस्तव विशाम्पते। जुगोप भीष्मासाद्य प्राथयानो महद् यशः॥
en: Then O ruler of earth, your son, supported by a mighty division, advanced to rescue Bhishma, out of a desire for securing great fame.

sa: ततः पार्थो धनुर्गृह्य दिव्यं जलदनिःस्वनम्। पातयामास भीष्मस्य धनुश्छित्त्वा त्रिभिः शरैः॥
en: Then Partha took up his celestial bow whose twang resembled the roar of the clouds and cut down Bhishma's bow with his sharp arrows.

sa: रथं नागं हयं चापि पत्तिनश्च विशाम्पते। एकैकेनेषुणा संख्ये निर्बिभेद महारथः॥
en: That mighty car-warrior, o king, then in that battle, began to pierce car-warriors, elephants and steeds and foot-soldiers each with a single arrow only.

sa: संचुकोच महाराज चर्मेवाग्नौ समाहितम्। भग्नं तु स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा भगदत्तेन धीमता॥
en: Contracted, O monarch, like a piece of hide held over a blazing fire. Beholding his own army thus routed by the highly inteiligent Bhagadatta,

sa: तां न देवा न गन्धर्वा नासुरोरगराक्षसाः। उत्सहन्तेऽन्यथा कर्तुं प्रतिज्ञां सव्यसाचिनः॥
en: Neither the Gods, nor the Gandharvas, nor the Asuras, nor the reptiles nor the Rakshasas would venture to baffle that Vow of Savyasachin (Arjuna).

sa: महेश्वरोऽपि पार्थेन श्रूयते योधितः पुरा। पदातिना महावीर्यो गिरौ हिमवति प्रभुः॥
en: It is said that the son of Pritha (Arjuna), on foot, fought with Almighty Mahesvara himself in days gone by, on the Himavat mountains.

sa: अवप्लुत्य रथात् तूर्णं तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः। समुद्यम्य गदां गुर्वी यमदण्डोपमां रणे॥
en: And jumping down from his car he stood fixed like the immovable hills, uplifting his heavy mace that resembled the bludgeon of Death himself.

sa: तथा कंसो महातेजा जरासंधेन पालितः। विक्रमेणैव कृष्णेन सगणः पातितो रणे॥
en: Also Kansa of great vigour who was protected by Jarasandha himself, was slain with his followers, in battle, by Krishna with his prowess alone.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु तैः सर्वैर्मूषिकैः स विशाम्पते। प्रत्युवाच ततः सर्वान् मूषिकान् मूषिकान्तकृत्॥
en: Being thus spoken to by all those mice, O lord of the universe, that destroyer of mice then spoke in reply to those mice.

sa: भीष्म त्वमसि धर्मज्ञः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः। श्रुत्वा च वचनं धर्म्यं मह्यं कर्तुमिहार्हसि॥
en: O Bhishma, you are conversant with virtue and all sciences and it is proper that you should do the right thing after hearing me.

sa: ततः समभवद् युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्। राक्षसानां च मुख्यस्य दुर्योधनबलस्य च॥
en: Then commenced a fierce engagement capable of making the hair stand erect, between those foremost among Duryodhana's host and those among the Rakshasa's kinsmen.

sa: नेष्यन्ति समरे सेनां भीमा यौधिष्ठिरी नृप। महेन्द्रेणेव वीरेण पाल्यमानां किरीटिना॥
en: These will lead the terrible army of Yudhishthira, O ruler of men, protected by Kiritin (Arjuna) as by that hero namely the great Indra.

sa: अद्यानृण्यं गमिष्यामि पितॄणां मातुरेव च। ये त्वया सुनृशंसेन दीर्घकाल प्रवासिताः॥
en: This day will I liquidate the debt I owe to my fathers and mothers who had so bong been exited by your heartless self.

sa: पुरुजित् कुन्तिभोजश्च महेष्वासो महाबलः। मातुलो भीमसेनस्य स च मेऽतिरथो मतः॥
en: The conqueror of enemies, Kuntibhoja, that great bowman, endued with great strength, the maternal uncle of Bhimasena too, is an Atiratha, in my opinion.

sa: ददासि चेद् वरं मह्यं जीवग्राहं युधिष्ठिरम्। गृहीत्वा रथिनां श्रेष्ठं मत्समीपमिहानय॥
en: If you would at all accord me a boon, then having captured that foremost of car-warriors, Yudhishthira alive, do you bring him to me.

sa: शोचन् नन्दयते शत्रून् कर्शयत्यपि बान्धवान्। क्षीयते च नरस्तस्मान्न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि॥
en: A man giving way to grief delights his enemies and saddens his friends and himself becomes reduced in (strength). Therefore you should not grieve.

sa: दश चैका चताः कृष्ण अक्षौहिण्यः सुदुर्जयाः। हतावशेषास्तत्रेमा हन्त माधव संख्यया॥
en: Alas! O Mahadeva, their invincible army of one and ten Akshauhini strong, consists of the remnants of their soldiers (slain during the last compaign).

sa: ग्रहणे हि जयस्तस्य न वधे पुरुषर्षभ। एतेन चाप्युपायेन ग्रहणं समुपैष्यसि॥
en: O foremost of men, victory depends on his capture and not on the death; and his capture can be brought about by this artifice.

sa: एतस्य बहुलाः सेनाः पञ्चालाश्च प्रभद्रकाः। तेनासौ रथवंशेन महत् कर्म करिष्यति॥
en: His large army consists of the Panchalas and the Prabhadrakas and with the help of these groups of cars he will do great deeds.

sa: अनुज्ञातौ क्षणे तस्मिन् भवेनार्जुनकेशवौ। प्रापतौ स्वशिविरं वीरौ मुदा परमया युतौ॥
en: Even at that moment obtaining the permission of Bhava, the two heroes Arjuna and Krishna, transported with delight came back to their own encampment.

sa: सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ। ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैव पापमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: Considering pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat, all the same, be ready for fight, and then, you will incur no sin.

sa: संजय उवाच उलूकस्यः वचः श्रुत्वा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। सेनां निर्यापयामास धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमाम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, hearing the words of Uluka, began to move his army at the head of which was Dhrishtadyumna.

sa: ततः शरसहस्राणि प्रमुञ्चन् पाण्डवो युधि। भीष्मं संछादयामास यथा मेघो दिवाकरम्॥
en: Thereafter that son of Pandu shooting in that battle thousands of arrows, covered Bhishma, like clouds covering the orb of the day. son arrows

sa: विध्वंसयित्वा समरे धनुष्मान् गाण्डीवमुक्तैर्निशितैः पृषत्कैः। भीष्मं यियासुर्युधि संददर्श दुर्योधनं सैन्धवादींश्च राज्ञः॥ संवारयिष्णूनभिवारयित्वा मुहूर्तमायोध्य बलेन वीरः।
en: That fierce bowman, destroyed them in battle, with arrows of exceeding sharpness shot from the Gandiva bow. Desirous of encountering Bhishma in battle, Dhananjaya then observed many kings including Duryodhana and the ruler of the Sindhus.

sa: अप्राप्तामथ तां शक्तिं पिता देवव्रतस्तव। त्रिधा चिच्छेद समरे सा पृथिव्यामशीर्यत॥
en: Your father Devavrata cut off in that battle that dart before it could reach his car. It then fell in fragments on the grounds.

sa: न चाहं कामये पापमपि कीटपिपीलयोः। किं पुनर्जातिषु वधं कामयेयं कथंचन॥
en: I do not desire to harm even the worms and ants; how can I then by any means desire the massacre of my kinsmen?

sa: संजय उवाच दुर्योधनस्य तद् वाक्य निशम्य भरतर्षभ। नेत्राभ्यामतिताम्राभ्यां कैतव्य समुदैक्षत॥
en: Sanjaya said That foremost of the Bharata race, hearing those words of Duryodhana, looked on that son of a gambler with eyes excessively red.

sa: न हि सोऽस्ति पुमाँल्लोके य: संक्रुद्धं वृकोदरम्। द्रष्टुमत्युग्रकर्माणं विषहेत नरर्षभम्॥
en: There breathes none in the world who can cast his eye on the foremost of men, Vrikodara of fearful deeds, when he is enraged.

sa: अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम्। यद् राज्यसुखलोभेन हन्तुं स्वजनमुद्यताः॥
en: Alas, we are engaged in committing a great sin. We are to kill our own kinsmen for the greed of the pleasures of sovereignty.

sa: गारुडं च महाव्यूह चक्रे शान्तनवस्तदा। पुत्राणां ते जयाकाङ्क्षी भीष्मः कुरुपितामहः॥
en: The chastiser of foes, the son of Shantanu, with the desire to win victory for your son then formed that great Vyuha called Garuda.

sa: इदं घोरमिदं चित्रमिदं रौद्रमिति प्रभो। तत्र युद्धान्यदृश्यन्त प्रततानि बहूनि च॥
en: Many were the combats that were seen raging on that field; O lord, some of which were dreadful, some wonderful and some exceedingly terrible.

sa: तत् तथा तव पुत्रस्य सैन्यं युधि परंतप। प्रभग्नं द्रुतमाविग्नमतीव शरपीडितम्॥
en: Then O scorcher of foes, the troops of your son afflicted with the arrows of Arjuna, deserted their ranks and fled from the field.

sa: द्विगुणं जवमास्थाय कम्पयंश्चरणैर्महीम्। तस्य तत् सुमहद् रूपं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे महारथाः॥
en: It doubled its speed and shook the earth under death its tread. Then all those mighty car-warriors, seeing that dreadful aspect of the animal,

sa: त्रय एते महानागा राक्षसैः समधिष्ठिताः। महाकायास्त्रिधा राजन् प्रस्रवन्तो मदं बहु॥
en: All these three mighty elephants ridden by Rakshsasa were possessed of prodigious bodies with the temporal juice profusely exuding from their temples. of pure

sa: सगजं भगदत्तं तु हन्तुकामः परंतपः। ते चान्ये चोदिता नागा राक्षसैस्तैर्महाबलैः॥
en: Being desirous, O afflicter of your foes, of slaying Bhagadatta along with his elephants. Goaded by the Rakshasas, of great strength, the other elephants.

sa: सूपस्करैरधिष्ठानैरीषादण्डकबन्धुरै :। चक्रैर्विमथितैरक्षैर्भग्नैश्च बहुधा युगे॥
en: With innumerable Upasakas, Adisthanas, shafts, crowns, broken car-wheels shattered Akshas and yokes.

sa: भीष्मः शान्तनवो भूयो भारद्वाजमभाषत। न रोचते मे संग्रामो हैडिम्बेन दुरात्मना॥
en: The son of Shantanu, namely, Bhishma again addressed the son of Bharadvaja saying:I do not like to fight with the wicked-souled son of Hidimba.

sa: संजय उवाच अथ शूरा महाराज परस्परकृतागसः। जग्मुः स्वशिबिराण्येव रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then, O mighty monarch, those heroes literally bespattered with blood, keeping alive their enmity for one another, retired to their respective tents.

sa: तं कथं पाण्डवं युद्धे दहन्तमिव पावकम्। प्रतियोत्स्यामि दुर्धर्षे तमहं शस्त्रकोविदम्॥
en: How can I encounter that invincible son of Pandu, accomplished in the use of all kinds of weapons and resembling the all-destroying fire itself.

sa: द्रुपदो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः पृथिवीपते। सौभद्रश्च महाबाहुः शङ्खान् दध्मुः पृथक् पृथक्॥
en: Drupada, and the sons of Draupadi and the mighty armed son of Subhadra, O king of all the world, each blew his conch separately.

sa: निश्चयो वापि कस्तेषां तदा ह्यासीन्महात्मनाम्। विमुखेषु महाप्राज्ञ मम पुत्रेषु संजय॥
en: What, O highly wise one, the resolution of these high-souled warriors, when, O Sanjaya, my sons turned away their faces from the field? was

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा सोदर्यैः परिवारितः। सौमदत्तिं रणे यत्तः समन्तात् पर्यवारयत्॥
en: Thereupon king Duryodhana, encircled by his uterine brothers, surrounded (for supporting him) the son of Somadatta, who had been striving hard in the encounter.

sa: तिष्ठन्तमग्रे तं दृष्ट्वा प्रतिविध्यं महाहवे। द्रौणिर्मानं पितुः कुर्वन् मार्गणैः समवारयत्॥
en: The son of Drona, seeing Prativindhya stand before him in that battle, checked him with arrows, in order to do honour to his sire.

sa: नाशक्नुतां वारयितुं भीष्ट्रोणौ महारथौ। वार्यमाणं च भीष्ममेण द्रोणेन च महात्मना॥
en: And those two great car-warriors Bhishma and Drona could not stop them. Though attempted to be stopped by Bhishma and the high souled Drona.

sa: ते वध्यमानाः पार्थेन शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। अमुास्तत्र तत्रैव त्रस्ता मृगगणा इव॥
en: the Then they, slaughtered with the close joined shafts of Partha, were over-whelmed with swoons, in that field, like a terrified herd of deer.

sa: पिनाकमिव रुद्रस्य क्रुद्धस्याभिघ्नतः पशून्॥ यथा पशूनां संघातं यष्ट्या पालः प्रकालयेत्।
en: And (lastly) which resembled the Pinaka of the enraged Rudra engaged in slaughtering animals. Just as a herdsman belabours his herd with a cudgel,

sa: भुजगा इव संक्रुद्धा लेलिहाना विषोल्बणाः॥ समाविशन्ति मर्माणि नेमे बाणाः शिखण्डिनः।
en: Like infuriate snakes of virulent venom with their tongues protruding out these arrows are penetrating into my very vitals. Surely these are not Shikhandin's.

sa: तं शब्दं तुमुलं श्रुत्वा पाण्डवानां महारथाः॥ अभ्यधावन् परीप्सन्तः फाल्गुनं भरतर्षभ।
en: Hearing that dreadful din, the mighty carwarriors of the Pandava host rushed to battle desirous of rescuing that foremost of the Bharatas, viz., Phalguna.

sa: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च। अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते॥
en: Presiding over the ear, the eye, the organs of touch, taste and smell, and the mind. It (the Self) enjoys all objects of senses.

sa: ततः सेनामुखे तस्मिन् स्थितः पार्थो धनुर्धरः॥ मध्येन कुरुसैन्यानां द्रावयामास वाहिनीम्।
en: Then Partha, holding his bow and standing at the head of his divisions broke the Kuru ranks in the very centre of their array.

sa: विगाह्य तद् गजानीकं भीमसेनोऽपि पाण्डवः। व्यचरत् समरे मृद्गन् गजानिन्द्रो गिरीनिव॥
en: Then Bhimasena the son of Pandu, also penetrating that division of elephants, careered in the filed, crushing the elephants, like Indra crushing the mountains.

sa: तुषारा यवनाश्चैव शकाश्च सह चूचुपैः। दक्षिणं पक्षमाश्रित्य स्थिता व्यूहस्य भारत॥
en: The Tusharas, the Yavanas, the Shakas, together with the Chuchupa, placing themselves in the right wing of that array prepared for battle, O Bharata.

sa: तस्य तन्मतमाज्ञाय गङ्गा हिमवतः सुता॥ महर्षीन् हंसरूपेण प्रेषयामास तत्र वै।
en: Ascertaining that to be his intention, Ganga, the daughter of the Himalayas sent great sages under the disguise of swans then to Bhishma. one,

sa: यदेकः समरे पार्थान् सार्जुनान् समयोधयत्। न चैनं पाण्डवा युद्धे वारयामासुरुल्बणम्॥
en: For then he, single-handed, fought with the Pandavas including Arjuna himself; he then fought so fiercely that the Pandavas were unable to resist him.

sa: दक्षिणावर्त आदित्ये एतन्मे मनसि स्थितम्॥ गमिष्यामि स्वकं स्थानमासीद् यन्मे पुरातनम्।
en: As long as the sun will remain in the Southern solstice. This indeed is my determination, I shall repair to my own former abode,

sa: तस्मिन् हते महासत्त्वे भरतानां पितामहे॥ न किंचित् प्रत्यपद्यन्त पुत्रास्ते भरतर्षभ।
en: When that grandsire of the Bharatas, possessed of great strength was overthrown, O foremost of the Bharatas, your sons knew not what to do.

sa: विषादाच्च चिरं कालमतिष्ठन् विगतेन्द्रियाः॥ दध्युश्चैव महाराज न युद्धे दधिरे मनः।
en: With their senses deprived of their powers in consequence of grief, they remained inert and reflected for long and did not think of fighting.

sa: तथैव राजा बाह्रीको राजानं दुपदं शरैः। आद्रवन्तं सहानीकः सहानीकं न्यवारयत्॥
en: Then king Valhika also at the head of his army, resisted, with his arrows, king Drupada the latter was advancing leading a formidable division,

sa: अधीयतां भवान् वेदान् सार्धं पुत्रेण धीमता। विधुन्वन् ब्रह्मघोषेण रक्षाभयकृतं तमः॥
en: Do you with your intelligent son recite the Vedas, and do you with the echoes of Vedic sounds remove the fears of the Rakshasas.

sa: तस्य स्म स्थाणुभूतस्य निर्विचेष्टस्य भारत। कुलिङ्गशकुनौ राजन् नीडं शिरसि चक्रतुः॥
en: While he stood there unmoved like a wooden post, О Bharata, a pair of Kulinga birds, O king, built their nest on his head.

sa: सुमन्तुजैमिनिश्चैव पैलश्च सुदृढव्रतः॥ अहं चतुर्थः शिष्यो वै पञ्चमश्च शुकः स्मृतः।
en: Sumanta, and Jaimini, and Paila of firm vows, and myself as the fourth, and Shuka. as the fifth, were disciples of the illustrious Vyasa.

sa: अथवास्तंगते सूर्ये संध्याकाल उपस्थिते। ततो नेष्यथ वा पुत्रमिहस्था वा भविष्यथ॥
en: Stay here till the sun sets and the evening comes. You may then take away this boy with yourselves or remain here with him.

sa: गुरुभ्य आसनं देयं कर्तव्यं चाभिवादनम्। गुरूनभ्यर्च्य युज्यन्ते आयुषा यशसा श्रिया॥
en: One should offer seats to his elders and respectfully bow to them. One obtains long life, fame, and prosperity, by a doing his elders.

sa: सांख्यं च योगं च सनातने द्वे वेदाश्च सर्वे निखिलेन राजन्। सर्वैः समस्तैर्ऋषिभिर्निरुक्तो नारायणो विश्वमिदं पुराणम्॥
en: The Sankhya and the Yoga Systems are eternal. All the Vedas, again, O king, are eternal. The Rishis, in all these systems or religion, have said that this universe existing from ancient times is Narayana's self.

sa: इह त्यक्त्वा न तिष्ठन्ति बान्धवा बान्धवं प्रियम्। स्नेहमुत्सृज्य गच्छन्ति बाष्पपूर्णाविलेक्षणाः॥
en: Leaving dead kinsman however dear, kinsman leave this spot. With eyes full of tcars, they go away, ccasing to show affection for the dead.

sa: एतत् ते कथितं पुत्र मयाऽऽख्यानमनुत्तमम्। यथा हि विजितो मृत्युर्गृहस्थेन पुराभवत्॥
en: I have now recited to you, my son, this excellent story as to how Death was conquered in days of yore by a householder.

sa: न च शोचति नाप्येनं स्थाविर्यमपकर्षति। श्रिया हीनोऽपि यो गेहमम्बेति प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: The man who, thought shorn of prosperity, enters his house uttering the words-0 mother!-does not suffer from grief. Nor does decrepitude ever attack him.

sa: तं गच्छ द्विजमुख्यं त्वं स मद्वाक्यप्रचोदितः। कामानभीप्सितांस्तुभ्यं दाता नास्त्यत्र संशयः॥
en: Go to him, O foremost of Brahmanas! That chief, at my request, will, forsooth, give you as much wealth as you wish to have.

sa: अहं त्वामभिजानामि विदितश्चासि मे दुम। पितामहः प्रजासर्गे त्वयि विश्रान्तवान् प्रभुः॥
en: I know you well. You are no stranger to me. While creating the world, the powerful Grandfather had for a time rested under you.

sa: इदं च रमणीयं ते प्रतिभाति वनस्पते। यदिमे विहगास्तात रमन्ते मुदितास्त्वयि॥
en: O king of the forest, this your hue is delightful since these birds, O child, filled with joy, sport on your twigs and branches.

sa: एतन्निःश्रेयसकरं ज्ञानं ते परमं मया। कथितं तत्त्वतस्तात श्रुत्वा देवर्षितो नृप॥
en: Having heard it, O king, from the celestial Rishi, I have, O son, given to you that great knowledge which yields the highest good.

sa: एवं प्राप्तो महत्कृच्छ्रमृषिः सन्नृपसत्तम। ब्राह्मणेन न वक्तव्यं तस्माद् वर्णावरे जने॥
en: In this way, O best of kings, that twice born Rishi fell into great distress. The Brahmana should, therefore, never give instructions to Shudras.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा प्रसृतमजस्रमुग्रवेगं गच्छन्तं सततमिहाव्यपेक्षमाणम्। चक्षुस्ते यदि न परप्रणेतृनेयं धर्मे ते भवतु मनः परं निशाम्य॥
en: If your eyes be not blind, seeing then that horse continually moving forward in its invisible course, do you set your heart on virtue, after hearing what your preceptors have 10 say about the next world.

sa: कदाचिल्लभते प्रीतिं कदाचिदपि शोचति। न सुखेन न दुःखेन कदाचिदिह युज्यते॥
en: Sometimes it acquires cheerfulness, sometimes it yields to grief and sometimes its condition becomes such that it is united with neither joy nor sorrow.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अनर्थानामधिष्ठानमुक्तो लोभः पितामह। अज्ञानमपि वै तात श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have said, O grandfather, that the root of all evils is covetousness. I wish, O sire, to licar fully of ignorance.

sa: अपि तावन्ममाप्येवं दद्यात् स भगवाञ्छिवः। दर्शनं मुनिशार्दूल प्रसादं चापि शंकरः॥
en: Will the powerful Shiva, will the great Shankara, O chief of ascetics, grant me also a sight of his body and show me favour?

sa: नाभ्युत्थाने मनुष्याणां योगाः स्युर्नात्र संशयः। व्याधिभिश्च विमथ्यन्ते व्याधैः क्षुद्रमृगा इव॥
en: Forsooth, when persons are attacked by diseases as little animals assailed by hunters, they then lose the power of rising up and moving about.

sa: स्तवमेतं भगवतो ब्रह्मा स्वयमधारयत्। गीयते च स बुद्ध्येत ब्रह्मा शंकरसंनिधौ॥
en: This hymn was borne by Brahma himself. Indeed, Brahman had sung it before Shankara. You are a Brahmana. You will therefore, comprehend it well.

sa: योगकृत्यं तु योगानां ध्यानमेव परं बलम्। तच्चापि द्विविधं ध्यानमाहुर्विद्याविदो जनाः॥
en: Contemplation, which forms an obligatory practice with Yogins, is their highest power, Those conversant with Yoga say that that Contemplation is of two sorts.

sa: अत्र मे संशयश्चैव कौतूहलमतीव च। किंस्वित् प्रहरणं श्रेष्ठं सर्वयुद्धषु पार्थिव॥
en: I have this doubt, and I am anxious to know the truth. Which, O king, is really the foremost of weapons in all battles.

sa: राजधर्मा बकः प्राह प्रणिपत्य पुरन्दरम्। यदि तेऽनुग्रहकृता मयि बुद्धि सुरेश्वर॥ सखायं मे सुदयितं गौतमं जीवयेत्युत।
en: After Indra had become silent, Rajadharman, having bowed unto the king of the gods, said, O king of gods, if you wish to show me favour, then let my dear friend Gautama be restored to life.

sa: स्वभावप्रेरिताः सर्वे निविशन्ते गुणा यदा। शुभाशुभास्तदा तत्र कस्य किं मानकारणम्॥
en: Indeed, when all qualities, good or bad, enter a person impelled by Nature, what is there for one to boast (of his superior possessions)?

sa: भगवन्नाश्रमाः सर्वे पृथगाचारदर्शिनः। इदं श्रेय इदं श्रेय इति सर्वे प्रबोधिताः॥
en: O illustrious one, the different modes of life approve different courses of conduct,-'This is beneficial,'_'This is beneficial',-the scriptures exhort us often in this way.

sa: कथा च येयं नृपते प्रसक्ता देवे महावीर्यमतौ शुभेयम्। योगी स सर्वानभिभूय मान् नारायणात्मा कुरुते महात्मा॥
en: This topic, "O king, about the Supreme Being of mighty energy should be considered as auspicious.” The Yogin has Narayana for his soul. Lording over all things, the great Yogin is capable of creating all things.

sa: पतिव्रतात्वं भार्यायाः परमो धर्म उच्यते। तवोपदेशान्नागेन्द्र तच्च तत्त्वेन वेद्मि वै॥
en: Chastity and obedience to the husband from the highest duty of wife. Through your instruction, O king of Nagas, I have learnt this well.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा विस्मिताः सर्वे गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणाः। ऋषयश्चैव संसिद्धाः परं विस्मयमागताः।१५॥
en: Seeing hiin, all the tribes of Apsaras and Gandharvas became filled with wonder. The Rishis also, that were crowned with success, became equally surprised.

sa: प्रतिकर्तुं न शक्ता ये बलस्थायापकारिणे। असूया जायते तीव्रा कारुण्याद् विनिवर्तते॥
en: When the person that injures is powerful and the one injured is unable to avenge the injury, hate appears. It disappears, however, through kindless.

sa: दुन्दुभिश्च तदा दिव्यस्ताडितो देवकिङ्करैः। ववौ च मारुतः पुष्पः शुचिगन्धः सुखावहः॥
en: The divine musicians began to play on their kettle drums. A delicious breeze fragrant and sweet, began to blow and fill me with pleasure.

sa: त्वामप्येवं सुदुर्धर्षं ज्वलन्तं परया श्रिया। काले परिणते कालः कालयिष्यति मामिव॥
en: When your hour will be full, Time will surely destroy you like me,-who are now so invincible and who now shine with matchless splendour.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तः प्रत्युवाचेदं गन्धवत्याः सुतः सुतम्। ऋषिस्तत्पूजयन् वाक्यं पुत्रस्यामिततेजसः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed the son of Gandhavati, viz., the Rishi, praising these words of his highly energetic son, replied to him as follows.

sa: तं गङ्गा सरितां श्रेष्ठा मेरुपृष्ठे जनेश्वर॥ स्वरूपिणी तदाभ्येत्य तर्पयामास वारिणा।
en: O king, coming to the breast of Meru, in her own embodied form, the foremost of rivers, viz., Ganga, bathed Shuka with her waters.

sa: एभ्यः प्रवर्तते दुःखमेभ्यः पापं प्रवर्तते। इति मयो विजानीयात् सततं पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: From these originate all sorts of grief. From these originate all sorts of sin. Every man, O foremost of men, should always know this.

sa: तस्मै राजन् सुरेन्द्राय नारदो वदतां वरः। आसीनायोपपन्नाय प्रोक्तवान् विपुलां कथाम्॥
en: Thus questioned, Narada, that foremost of speakers, O king, then began to recite to the king of the gods the extensive history that follows.

sa: स उवाच ततस्तां स्त्री स्नानोदकमिहानय। उपासिष्ये ततः सन्ध्यां वाग्यतो नियतेन्द्रिय॥
en: The Rishi addressed her saying 'Fetch water for my ablution! Having bathed, I shall recite my evening prayers, controlling my tongue and the senses.'

sa: तस्मै स सर्वमाचष्ट यथावृत्तं जनेश्वरः। शत्रुाभिर्ग्रहणं संख्ये पुत्रस्य मरणं तथा॥
en: The king told Narada all that had taken place, viz., the death of his son in battle and his own capture by his enemies.

sa: श्रुतास्त्वत्तः कथाश्चैव धर्मयुक्ता महामते। संदेहोऽस्ति तु कश्चिन्मे तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: I have also heard from you, O you of great intelligence, many discourses about morality. I have, however, one doubt. You should remove it.

sa: दुमाः शाखाश्च मुमुचुः शिखराणि च पर्वताः। निर्घातशब्दैश्च गिरिहिमवान् दीर्यतीव ह॥
en: The trees began to throw off their branches and the mountains their summits. Loud peals were heard that seemed to rive the Himavat mountains.

sa: मनसा क्लिश्यमानस्तु समाधानं च कारयेत्। न निर्वेदं मुनिर्गच्छेत् कुर्यादेवात्मनो हितम्॥
en: He should, though disturbed by the fickleness of his mind, fix it in meditation. The Yogin should never despair, but seek own his well-being.

sa: सर्वान् कामान् विधास्यामि रमस्व सहितो मया।।८४ रमणीये वने विप्र सर्वकामफलप्रदे।
en: I Shall satisfy every wish of yours! Do you sport with me, therefore, in these delightful forests, O Brahmana, which can grant every wish.

sa: तत एतानि संयम्य मनसि स्थापयेद् यतिः। तथैवापोह्य संकल्पान्मनो ह्यात्मनि धारयेत्॥
en: Having controlled these, he should fix there on the mind. Then withdrawing the mind from all purposes. He should settle it on the understanding.

sa: ततस्ते समभिदुत्य वराहं जगृहुः समम्। संक्रुद्धाश्च वराहं तं व्यकर्षन्त समन्ततः॥
en: Soon after, they all rushed against that Boar and caught it simultaneously. Filled with anger they tried to drag the animal from every side.
